title: Senior Key Account Manager
description:
About Us

Keeta, the international subsidiary of Meituan—the global delivery giant—is on a mission to revolutionize food and consumer product delivery worldwide. With our core belief: "We help people eat better, live better," we're taking innovation to the global stage! Within just one year, Keeta has become an industry leader in Hong Kong. With our ongoing expansions into Saudi Arabia, Keeta achieved the remarkable feat of launching 5 cities in just 17 days, allowing the Arab world to witness the speed of China! Keeta offers exciting opportunities to join a transformative journey that is shaping the future of delivery and retail. Join Keeta, explore the world.

What You'll Do

  • Responsible for the development and operation of regional chain brands, driving user acquisition and scale growth for assigned brands, leading the team to execute the company's sales strategies, and achieving performance targets;
  • Promote deep collaboration between regional chain brands and the platform in areas such as brand marketing, promotional activities, and user operations, enhancing the partnership and stickiness between the brands and Keeta;
  • Based on the characteristics of the food and beverage industry, develop a deep understanding of categories and brand operation models, identify business development opportunities, and formulate tactical plans covering (but not limited to) growth, marketing, user experience, and membership programs to strengthen Keeta’s influence within the industry;
  • Establish strong communication with the delivery department, acting as a bridge between brands and the platform’s delivery operations, and work collaboratively to continuously optimize the brand delivery service experience;
  • Fully leverage personal work potential, gather frontline marketing information, user feedback, and local market dynamics to provide valuable insights and references for the company's decision-making.

What We Need From You

  • Over 8 years of experience in key account management, channel development, or retail management, with a solid foundation in management methodologies and practices.
  • Strong business negotiation and market expansion skills, with a keen ability to identify client and user needs and a proactive attitude toward challenges.
  • Experienced in process and project management, with the ability to drive multiple tasks and projects concurrently.
  • Highly reliable and resilient, demonstrating strong work enthusiasm and a collaborative team spirit.
  • Fluent in English (speaking, reading, and writing) and capable of using it as a working language; proficiency in Portuguese is a strong plus.

Why Join Keeta

Keeta is redefining the future of food delivery with a clear vision and innovative spirit. As a fast-scaling brand under Meituan's global ambition, we offer a unique blend of stability and startup energy, providing boundless opportunities for personal and professional growth. Whether you want to specialize in your field or gain cross-functional experience, Keeta empowers you to take charge of your career.

As we expand globally, we are committed to building a workplace that reflects our unique culture while incorporating global best practices. You'll be part of a company that's transforming the delivery industry while supporting local communities, empowering merchants, and delivering outstanding customer experiences.

At Keeta, you'll collaborate with a passionate and pragmatic global team across over 94 countries, bringing diverse perspectives that drive creativity and innovation. We believe diversity is our strength and it pushes us to deliver better solutions for our customers and partners in Hong Kong, Saudi Arabia, and beyond.

Keeta offers limitless career growth and equal development opportunities, empowering you to grow as the company grows. Every day presents an opportunity for you to make a meaningful impact, grow professionally, and be part of something extraordinary. You'll thrive in a dynamic environment where every contribution is valued. Together, let's build the future of food delivery.

title: Resource Manager, Professional Services
description:
Title: Resource Manager, Professional Services

Business Unit: Graphic Communications

Department: Customer & Professional Services

Location: Brazil, Remote

About us

Graphic Communications, a CAI Division, is a leading global provider of industry-specific business and production software technology for the print industy. Graphic Communications’ integrated and automated offerings and point solutions are designed to enable revenue growth and drive operating and production efficiencies. With over thirty years dedicated to delivering best-in-class technology to the packaging and printing industries, it is the company's deeply held philosophy that they succeed when its customers thrive.

Position Overview

The Resource Manager plays a critical role in ensuring Professional Services teams are properly staffed, aligned, and equipped to meet project timelines and business objectives. This role involves close collaboration with Project Managers, Project Coordinators, Regional Managers, the Sr. Director of Professional Services, Customer Success, and Sales to efficiently manage resources, balance workloads, and ensure smooth project delivery.

Core Responsibilities

Resource Planning and Allocation

  • Identify, assign, and allocate resources to ongoing and upcoming projects based on skills, availability, and priorities.
  • Maintain a real-time view of resource capacity and project needs across the organization.
  • Serve as the primary point of contact for project staffing and collaborate with Sales and Regional Managers to ensure proper coverage for upcoming engagements.
  • Own all new engagements at intake and assign resources based on availability and skillset.
  • Check in regularly with Project Managers to confirm they have the resources required for project success.
  • Maintain up-to-date skills and certifications records for all consultants. Forecasting and Talent Management
  • Collaborate with Sales, Project Managers, Regional Managers, and leadership to forecast future resource requirements.
  • Identify resource gaps and recommend cross-training, recruitment, or subcontracting needs based on upcoming opportunities.
  • Support long-term workforce planning and professional development of consultants.

Process Optimization and Tool Management

  • Develop and maintain tools, dashboards, and reports to monitor utilization, productivity, and performance.
  • Establish and enforce consistent processes for resource requests and assignments to maximize efficiency.
  • Ensure data and processes remain aligned across systems.

Daily Operational Responsibilities

New Engagement Intake

  • Review new projects pushed from Salesforce into Wrike.
  • Confirm all project metadata: customer, region, product, estimated hours, and key contacts.
  • Confirm the correct Wrike template and folder structure were created.
  • If automation fails, manually create projects using Salesforce data.

Assignment & Scheduling

  • Review unassigned Wrike projects daily.
  • Match consultants to projects based on skill set, availability, and regional needs.
  • Assign both primary and secondary consultants and confirm schedules with stakeholders.
  • Flag any assignment conflicts or delays to Regional Managers or Services Leads.

System Sync and Integration Oversight

  • Cross-reference Salesforce → Wrike and Wrike → NetSuite mappings to ensure accuracy.
  • Validate billing fields (sold-to ID, billing trigger, engagement type) and confirm correct syncing.
  • Ensure Concur sync processes are updating users, vendors, and expenses accurately.
  • Monitor Wrike integration logs and escalate issues as needed.
  • Maintain field mapping and oversee sync processes across Salesforce, NetSuite, and Concur.
  • Track and resolve open integration issues in collaboration with Operations.

Time Tracking Oversight

  • Validate daily timesheet entries for all consultants.
  • Identify missing, misallocated, or excessive time entries and follow up as needed.
  • Escalate persistent noncompliance to Regional Managers.
  • Ensure adherence to time entry policies for accurate utilization and billing reporting.

Project Health & Status Monitoring

  • Monitor project dashboards in Wrike for task completion, budget consumption, and forecasted effort.

Reporting & Communication

  • Participate in regular syncs with Regional Managers.
  • Track upcoming projects, resourcing constraints, and urgent escalations.
  • Respond to inquiries regarding capacity, project swaps, or timeline adjustments.
  • Provide data for utilization, staffing, revenue forecasting, and any other Professional Services metrics.

Performance and Collaboration

  • Monitor workload balance across consultants.
  • Participate in resource reviews with Regional Managers to support continuous development based on Sales forecast.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with Sales, Customer Success, and Professional Services teams to align timelines, priorities, and dependencies.

Qualifications

Experience:

  • 4+ years of experience in resource planning or operations within a software or technology organization.
  • Proven ability to manage multiple concurrent projects and balance resources effectively in a fast-paced environment.

Skills:

  • Strong proficiency with resource planning tools (e.g., Wrike)
  • Working knowledge of JIRA, Salesforce, required, and NetSuite preferred.
  • Excellent organizational, communication, and negotiation skills.

title: Pessoa Supervisora de Auditoria e Performance
description:
ALLOS é uma marca com uma forte herança. São cerca de 50 anos de experiência, transformando o mercado no Brasil. Somos referência em excelência e inovação, com a qualidade e confiança que faz parte da nossa história.

A nova marca surgiu pronta para o futuro, a partir da fusão entre a Aliansce Sonae e a brMalls, em 2023. Mas, essa trajetória começou bem antes.

Tudo começou com a Aliansce, que inaugurou o primeiro shopping da região Nordeste e o segundo do Brasil em 1975. Em 2019, a fusão entre a Aliansce e a Sonae Sierra deu origem à Aliansce Sonae, tornando-se líder na administração de shoppings no Brasil, com 32 empreendimentos. Em 2006, surge a brMalls resultando em um portfólio de 30 ativos presentes nas cinco regiões do país.

E assim, em 2023, a ALLOS surge com o encontro de duas potências nacionais do segmento, unindo forças para se tornar a mais inovadora plataforma de entretenimento, lifestyle, serviços e compras.

Nossa história continua e estamos prontos para criar momentos que transformam e impactam a vida das pessoas, gerando conexões e oportunidades.

title: Analista de Fretes Pl / SP
description:
Será responsável pelo processo de validação, conferência e pagamento de Conhecimentos de Transporte Eletrônico (CT-e) e despesas adicionais relacionadas ao transporte. Atenderá a nossos clientes internos e transportadores, mantendo comunicação constante para a solução de pendências e alinhamento de procedimentos operacionais, além de contribuir para a melhoria contínua dos processos, identificação de oportunidades.

Responsabilidades da Posição:

Validação de CT-es e Tarifas Aplicadas:

Realizar a conferência dos arquivos XML de CT-es recebidos, verificando se as tarifas aplicadas estão de acordo com as tabelas negociadas, identificando divergências e garantindo conformidade com as regras internas de transporte. Confirmar se o CT-e está ativo na SEFAZ, com autorização válida e sem inconsistências fiscais que possam impactar o processo de pagamento. Checar se o transporte foi efetivamente realizado, analisando status de entrega, ocorrências registradas e demais informações que assegurem a execução do serviço.

Processamento e Pagamento de Fretes e Despesas Adicionais:

Efetuar a validação e liberação de pagamentos de fretes e despesas adicionais justificadas, garantindo que todas as cobranças estejam alinhadas aos critérios previamente estabelecidos.

Redução de CT-es Manuais e Identificação de Ocorrências:

Acompanhar e monitorar a emissão de CT-es manuais, identificando trechos, transportadores ou rotas com maior incidência e propondo melhorias para redução de retrabalho e aumento da eficiência.

Geração de Insights Operacionais de Custos:

Levantar dados básicos sobre rotas e trechos, indicadores de oportunidades e comportamentos fora do padrão, contribuindo com visibilidade para ações de melhoria.

Apoio e Alinhamento com Transportadores:

Sanar dúvidas de transportadores sobre tarifas, divergências, status de pagamento e regras operacionais, mantendo comunicação clara e cooperativa para solução de pendências.

Suporte às Áreas Internas em Demandas de Frete:

Atender solicitações internas relacionadas a fretes T1, auxiliando com informações, análises simples e validações necessárias ao fluxo de pagamento e controle operacional.

Requisitos do Perfil:

  • Formação: Graduação completa em áreas como Administração, Logística, Contabilidade ou afins.
  • Experiência anterior na área de logística ou financeiro, com foco em pagamentos de fretes e análise de despesas; Conhecimento em sistemas SAP, QS3 e MDC; Habilidade para lidar com grandes volumes de dados e informações complexas; Capacidade de análise crítica, atenção a detalhes e resolução de problemas; Boa comunicação e habilidades de relacionamento interpessoal.
  • Conhecimentos Técnicos: Excel nível avançado, SAP, Access e Power BI, QS3.
  • Competências Interpessoais: Relacionamento Interpessoal, influência, Negociação, Foco no Cliente, Trabalho em equipe, Inovação, Visão Global, adaptabilidade.

title: Lead WordPress Developer
description:
Given that this position requires English proficiency, we are only considering CV's provided in English. Thank you, and we look forward to your submission!

About Olly Olly

Olly Olly is a $25M ARR digital marketing company serving small businesses across the United States. We've built our reputation on transparency, results, and making sophisticated marketing accessible to business owners who need to focus on running their companies, not learning marketing complexities. As we scale our platform and demand generation efforts, we're looking for an exceptional WordPress developer who can lead our landing page creation and optimization function.

The Role

We're seeking a battle-tested WordPress Developer & Landing Page Team Lead who has personally managed the technical execution of high-stakes marketing campaigns with millions of dollars in ad spend. This isn't a role for someone who's built a few landing pages—we need someone who has been THE person responsible for ensuring every pixel fires correctly, every form submits properly, and every dollar of ad spend has a clear path to conversion tracking.

You'll lead a team of two WordPress developers, managing multiple concurrent projects while maintaining the exacting standards required when significant marketing budgets are on the line. You'll be the technical bridge between our marketing campaigns (primarily Meta, but across various channels) and our HubSpot CRM, ensuring flawless data flow and attribution tracking.

Core Responsibilities

Landing Page Development & Campaign Execution

  • Design, build, and deploy high-converting landing pages optimized for paid traffic from Meta, Google, and other advertising platforms
  • Own the complete technical implementation of marketing campaigns from concept through launch
  • Ensure pixel-perfect tracking setup across all campaigns, including Meta Pixel, Google Analytics, conversion tracking, and retargeting audiences
  • Implement and troubleshoot complex tracking scenarios including server-side tracking, UTM parameters, and multi-touch attribution
  • Optimize landing page performance for speed, mobile responsiveness, and conversion rates
  • Conduct A/B testing and implement rapid iterations based on campaign performance data

HubSpot Integration & Data Management

  • Build and maintain seamless integrations between landing pages and HubSpot CRM
  • Ensure accurate lead capture, form submissions, and data synchronization
  • Implement and validate proper lead source attribution and campaign tracking in HubSpot
  • Create custom workflows and automations to support campaign objectives
  • Troubleshoot data discrepancies and ensure marketing attribution accuracy

Technical Leadership & Team Management

  • Lead and mentor a team of two WordPress developers
  • Manage workload distribution across multiple concurrent projects and campaigns
  • Establish and enforce development standards, quality assurance protocols, and best practices
  • Conduct code reviews and provide constructive technical feedback
  • Create project timelines and ensure on-time delivery of campaign assets
  • Serve as the escalation point for complex technical challenges

Quality Assurance & Risk Management

  • Implement rigorous QA processes, before any campaign launch.
  • Verify all tracking mechanisms are functioning correctly across devices and browsers
  • Maintain detailed documentation of tracking implementations and technical specifications
  • Proactively identify and resolve potential issues before they impact campaign performance
  • Ensure compliance with privacy regulations (GDPR, CCPA) in all tracking implementations

Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of professional WordPress development experience
  • Direct experience managing technical execution of marketing campaigns with $1M+ in total ad spend
  • Must have been the PRIMARY person responsible for landing page build and campaign launch (not just a contributor on a larger team)
  • Portfolio demonstrating high-converting landing pages you've personally built and deployed

Technical Expertise

  • Proven experience implementing Git-based version control (GitLab, GitHub, or Bitbucket) and configuring Continuous Integration/Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) pipelines for WordPress. Must be proficient in automating deployment across environments (Dev, Staging, Prod) and integrating unit and end-to-end tests into the workflow.
  • Expert-level WordPress development skills including ACF. Gutenberg, custom theme development, plugin customization, and advanced page builders (Elementor, Divi, or similar)
  • Deep understanding of Meta Business Suite, Meta Pixel implementation, and Conversions API
  • Proven experience with HubSpot CRM integration, forms, and tracking implementation
  • Strong command of HTML, CSS, JavaScript/jQuery, and PHP
  • Experience with VueJS is a plus
  • Experience with conversion tracking pixels across multiple platforms (Meta, Google, LinkedIn, etc.)
  • Knowledge of Google Tag Manager and server-side tracking implementations
  • Understanding of marketing analytics, attribution models, and conversion optimization principles

Management & Communication

  • Demonstrated experience leading and mentoring developers
  • Exceptional project management skills with the ability to juggle multiple high-priority projects
  • Clear communication style with both technical and non-technical stakeholders
  • Comfortable with accountability when significant marketing budgets are at stake
  • Ability to explain complex technical concepts to marketing team members

Performance Standards

  • Meticulous attention to detail—one misconfigured pixel can cost thousands in wasted ad spend
  • Ability to work under pressure and meet tight campaign launch deadlines
  • Proactive problem-solver who anticipates issues before they become problems
  • Commitment to continuous learning as platforms and tracking methods evolve

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with marketing automation platforms beyond HubSpot (Marketo, Pardot, ActiveCampaign)
  • Familiarity with conversion rate optimization (CRO) methodologies and tools
  • Knowledge of SQL for custom reporting and data analysis
  • Experience with A/B testing platforms (VWO, Optimizely, Google Optimize)
  • Understanding of SEO best practices for landing pages
  • Certifications in Meta Blueprint, Google Analytics, or HubSpot
  • Experience in agency or fast-paced startup environments

What Success Looks Like

First 30 Days

  • Audit current landing page infrastructure and tracking implementations
  • Meet with marketing team to understand campaign objectives and conversion goals
  • Review existing team workflows and identify optimization opportunities
  • Successfully launch first campaign under your management with zero tracking issues

First 90 Days

  • Establish standardized QA protocols and documentation for all campaign launches
  • Implement improvements to team efficiency and project management processes
  • Build trust with marketing team through flawless technical execution
  • Identify and resolve any lingering tracking or integration issues

First Year

  • Lead team through successful execution of major product launch campaigns
  • Demonstrably improve landing page conversion rates through testing and optimization
  • Establish Olly Olly's landing page function as a competitive advantage
  • Develop your team members' skills and create succession planning

Why This Role Matters

When we invest in marketing campaigns, every dollar needs to count. You'll be the person ensuring that our tracking is accurate, our data is clean, and our ability to optimize is never compromised by technical issues. Your work directly impacts our ability to scale profitably and serve more small business owners.

Compensation & Benefits

Competitive salary commensurate with experience, plus comprehensive benefits package. This is a full-time remote position, though you'll be working closely with team members across time zones.

Our Culture

We value directness, authenticity, and results over politics or polish. We're building something meaningful for small business owners who are often underserved by the marketing industry. We expect excellence but also recognize that real growth happens when people are supported, challenged, and given autonomy to do their best work.

title: Executive Assistant
description:

What you’ll do?

Also, be able to present oneself as a representative of the Manager's office, and, to a very large and diverse internal and external audience.

title: Conversational AI Designer (Voice & Chat)
description:
Company Description

A Coru é líder em soluções de experiência de usuário para empresas, focada em desafiar o convencional por meio de sua plataforma inteligente e assistente digital ADI. Oferecemos experiências digitais humanizadas e hiperpersonalizadas, o que aumenta a geração de receita e a eficiência operacional de nossos parceiros.

Job Description

O Conversational AI Designer será responsável por desenhar, construir e otimizar agentes de IA (voz e chat) que interagem com usuários finais em casos de uso financeiros, operacionais e comerciais. É um cargo híbrido entre levantamento de requisitos, design conversacional e construção técnica do agente utilizando ferramentas no-code/low-code como ElevenLabs, ADI e plataformas de voicebots. Sua missão é garantir experiências conversacionais naturais, eficientes e alinhadas ao negócio, trabalhando em conjunto com POs, clientes e equipes técnicas.

Responsabilidades:

1. Discovery e levantamento de requisitos

  • Levantar processos, regras de negócio e necessidades do cliente;
  • Entrevistar stakeholders e mapear os journeys atuais (AS IS);
  • Analisar casos de uso, riscos, cenários críticos e métricas desejadas.

2. Design conversacional (Voz & Chat)

  • Criar fluxos, árvores conversacionais e intents;
  • Definir tom, personalidade e estilo do agente de IA;
  • Redigir diálogos naturais e eficientes (português/espanhol);
  • Estabelecer estratégias de manejo de objeções, quedas e redirecionamentos;
  • Validar a experiência conversacional em diferentes canais (voz, WhatsApp, web);
  • Apoiar equipes internas com ajustes avançados de lógica e estruturação de instruções do agente, garantindo clareza, consistência e eficácia nos comportamentos esperados.

3. Construção do agente

  • Implementar o voicebot/chatbot em ferramentas internas (ADI) ou plataformas equivalentes;
  • Configurar parâmetros, memória, contexto e comportamento do agente;
  • Integrar ElevenLabs para a voz do agente (TTS, sotaques, SSML opcional);
  • Realizar testes end-to-end e ajustar o comportamento com base em métricas reais.

4. Otimização e melhoria contínua

  • Analisar gravações, transcrições e dados de performance;
  • Ajustar instruções, lógica e fluxos para melhorar conversão e CSAT;
  • Garantir qualidade, consistência e cumprimento regulatório (quando aplicável).

Requisitos Obrigatórios

  • Experiência prévia no desenho de chatbots ou voicebots (mínimo 1 ano).
  • Conhecimento em design de diálogos, UX conversacional e fluxos de decisão.
  • Capacidade de levantar requisitos diretamente com clientes.
  • Excelentes habilidades de redação e comunicação.
  • Espanhol nativo ou avançado + português intermediário (desejável).
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas de IA generativa (ChatGPT, LLMs etc.).
  • Capacidade de trabalhar com equipes de produto e desenvolvimento.
  • Conhecimento de ElevenLabs, Twilio, Dialogflow, Rasa ou similares.
  • Experiência básica com JSON, chamadas de API ou integrações simples.

Você tem o perfil para ser um Coru?

Temos a convicção de que o mais importante de Coru são as pessoas, por isso é fundamental que você faça um “Fit” cultural com toda a equipe. Estes são os pilares da nossa cultura:

-Somos Todos Líderes.

-Rendirse jamás!

-El único problema que no podemos resolver es aquel del que no podemos hablar.

-All together: Diversidad de historias y vivencias. Diferentes visiones traen mayores horizontes.

title: Tax Lawyer
description:
Position: Tax Lawyer (Brazil) – Belo Horizonte

Location: Belo Horizonte, Minas Gerais

Employment Type: Full-time

About Ax Legal

Ax Legal is a corporate law and advisory firm that supports international mining, technology, engineering, and industrial services companies entering and operating in Latin America. We work closely with clients from Australia, Canada, the United States, and Europe, helping them navigate the legal and commercial requirements of operating in Chile, Peru, Brazil, and across the region.

We pride ourselves on combining legal expertise with practical, on-the-ground support that allows our clients to run lean local operations while scaling effectively.

Role Overview

We are looking for a Tax Lawyer based in Belo Horizonte who will support our clients with Brazilian tax structuring, compliance, and ongoing operational needs. This position is ideal for a lawyer who enjoys working directly with international companies and providing practical, business-focused advice.

Key Responsibilities

  • Advise clients on Brazilian federal, state, and municipal tax obligations related to incorporation, ongoing operations, and cross-border structures.
  • Provide guidance on tax implications of service agreements, transfer pricing, international payments, and permanent establishment concerns.
  • Support clients with monthly and annual tax compliance, including coordination with accountants where required.
  • Review and prepare legal opinions, memoranda, and reports related to tax matters.
  • Assist with tax planning strategies for foreign companies entering Brazil or expanding their footprint.
  • Liaise with government offices, tax authorities, and regulatory bodies as needed.
  • Work closely with the broader Ax Legal team in Chile and Peru to ensure regional consistency for multinational clients.
  • Participate in client meetings, onboarding processes, and project planning to ensure smooth operations in Brazil.
  • Support general corporate or commercial matters when tax expertise is required.

Qualifications

  • Law degree from a recognised Brazilian university.
  • Specialisation or postgraduate studies in Tax Law highly preferred.
  • Minimum 4–6 years of relevant experience, ideally with exposure to cross-border matters or multinational clients.
  • Strong understanding of Brazilian tax regimes, including  indirect taxation, corporate taxation and tax incentives.
  • Experience advising international companies is an advantage.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills both in English and Portuguese required.

Personal Attributes

  • Client-focused with a practical mindset.
  • Comfortable working independently while being part of a regional team.
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to manage multiple client matters simultaneously.
  • Proactive, organised, and solutions-driven.

What We Offer

  • The opportunity to work with innovative international companies in mining, technology, and industrial services.
  • A collaborative environment with colleagues across Latin America.
  • Professional growth and the chance to build a long-term specialised career within an international practice.
  • Competitive compensation and flexible working environment.

We are seeking a Front End AI Engineer with deep expertise in building high-quality, production-ready interfaces for AI-powered applications. This role focuses on leading the front-end architecture for advanced AI systems, including conversational interfaces, agent control panels, automation dashboards, and embedded AI workflows for client deployments. The ideal candidate is fluent in modern React, highly skilled in TypeScript, comfortable working across design systems, and efficient with AI-assisted development tools such as Cursor and Claude Code.

This is a senior-level role where you will serve as the point person for all front-end initiatives across multiple client projects. You will collaborate closely with our AI, automation, and product teams to translate complex agentic and generative AI capabilities into intuitive, reliable, and high-performance user experiences.

Key Responsibilities:

Front End Architecture and Development

  • Own the front-end strategy and implementation for AI-powered products and interfaces.
  • Build high-quality React applications using TypeScript, modular component architectures, and modern state management patterns.
  • Experience with design and Figma.
  • Use AI-enhanced development tools such as Cursor and Claude Code to accelerate development, improve quality, and maintain consistency across projects.
  • Design reusable component libraries tailored for AI interfaces, including chat interfaces, agent dashboards, workflow builders, analytics panels, and data visualization.
  • Ensure UX clarity when surfacing complex AI behavior, including agent states, reasoning paths, confidence indicators, and human-in-the-loop controls.
  • Coordinate with the backend and AI engineering teams to integrate REST APIs, WebSockets, vector search endpoints, automation pipelines, and generative model outputs.
  • Lead code reviews, establish front-end standards, and mentor engineers on best practices in AI-driven front-end development.

AI Interface Development

  • Build highly responsive conversational UI components for voice and text-based agents.
  • Develop systems to visualize agentic operations, multi-step workflows, and tool usage.
  • Implement secure user authentication and permissions for client-facing AI dashboards.
  • Work with designers to translate conceptual AI workflows into intuitive user flows and polished UI.
  • Collaborate with the AI engineering team to improve prompt workflows, data capture, and human override safety controls from the front-end layer.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Serve as the primary owner and technical authority for front-end delivery across all AI engagements.
  • Work closely with product managers, designers, AI engineers, and automation specialists to define scope and translate requirements into clear front-end plans.
  • Help clients understand interface possibilities and guide them toward the most effective implementation strategies.
  • Ensure that front-end systems meet client needs around reliability, accessibility, and performance.

Qualifications:

Required

  • 5+ years of professional experience as a front-end engineer.
  • Expert-level proficiency in React and TypeScript.
  • Design experience and using tools like Figma.
  • Demonstrated experience owning complex front-end applications from architecture through deployment.
  • Comfortable with AI-enhanced coding tools such as Cursor, Claude Code, and related platforms.
  • Familiarity with building AI-enabled interfaces, including chat UIs, real-time dashboards, visual workflows, or similar components.
  • Strong experience with API integration, authentication, and state management patterns.
  • Ability to work independently, set technical direction, and mentor less experienced developers.
  • Strong UX instincts and the ability to translate technical AI functionality into clear and usable interfaces.

Preferred

  • Experience building interfaces for LLM-powered systems, automation workflows, or agent-based applications.
  • Familiarity with vector databases, embeddings, or retrieval augmented UIs.
  • Experience with streaming updates, event-driven front-end patterns, or real-time systems.
  • Background in building interfaces for enterprise clients or complex operational environments.
  • Experience collaborating with AI engineers on prompt workflows and agent control features.

Work Environment and Benefits

  • Competitive compensation structure with performance incentives.
  • Flexible remote or hybrid work environment.
  • Opportunity to shape the front-end architecture for cutting-edge AI systems across multiple industries.
  • High-impact work with clients committed to modernization and operational transformation.

Os selecionados passarão por imersão no Projeto, recebendo treinamento sobre as atividades e uso dos sistemas de inspeção, a primeira fase de seleção é realizada integralmente online.

Buscamos profissionais que incorporem nossos valores, não têm medo de desafios, busquem inovar, experimentar e se aprimorar rapidamente. Estamos buscando Auditores Agrícolas que contribuirão com atividades de coleta de dados através do acompanhamento de testes transgênicos em pontos de recebimento de soja (PDR's) em silos, armazéns e cooperativas. title: Customer Success Manager (Google Ads - eCom) (Remote)
description:
About the Role

We’re looking for a Client Success & Account Lead to fully own a portfolio of eCommerce clients.

You’ll be the go-to person for the client and the internal captain who works with our Google Ads Strategists and Media Buyers to make sure accounts are performing, communication is tight, and nothing falls through the cracks.

If you love Google Ads, talking to clients, and driving clear outcomes (ROAS, revenue, profit) – this is for you.

What You’ll Own

1. Client Relationship & Communication

  • Be the primary point of contact for your client portfolio.
  • Run recurring check-in calls (weekly/bi-weekly/monthly), Loom updates, and strategy reviews.
  • Translate complex performance data into simple, clear, business-language the client understands.
  • Proactively manage expectations, timelines, and next steps.

2. Account & Performance Ownership

  • Work closely with our Google Ads Strategists & Media Buyers to ensure campaigns are aligned with the client’s goals (MER, ROAS, CAC, profit).
  • Review performance across accounts regularly and push the team on optimisations, tests, and scaling opportunities.
  • Spot issues early (conversion tracking, feed problems, drops in performance) and coordinate fast fixes.

3. Strategy & Planning

  • Help build and present quarterly and monthly strategies: budgets, scaling plans, testing roadmaps, new channels (Pmax, YouTube, etc.).
  • Understand the client’s wider business (margins, LTV, seasonality, stock, promos) and reflect that in the ad strategy.
  • Bring ideas to clients: new offers, funnels, landing pages, creatives, and experiments.

4. Reporting & Insight

  • Own performance reporting: weekly or monthly reports, Loom walk-throughs, and QBR decks where needed.
  • Focus on insight, not just screenshots – what happened, why it happened, and what we’re doing next.
  • Use dashboards / tools (GA4, Looker/Datastudio, Google Ads UI, etc.) to support decisions.

5. Retention, Growth & Upsell

  • Keep a pulse on client satisfaction and step in early if you sense churn risk.
  • Identify opportunities to grow accounts: higher budgets, additional services, new markets, YouTube, etc.
  • Aim to turn every account into a long-term partnership, not a short-term “vendor” relationship.

6. Internal Coordination & Process

  • Make sure tasks, priorities, and deadlines are clear for the internal team (usually via ClickUp/Slack/Loom).
  • Keep everyone aligned on what matters this week for each account (big rocks, tests, fixes).
  • Help maintain a high standard of client communication, documentation, and follow-through.

Requirements

Experience:

  • 3+ years working with Google Ads for eCommerce brands (agency side strongly preferred).
  • Proven experience managing multiple client accounts at once.

Google Ads & eCom Knowledge:

  • Solid hands-on understanding of Google Ads: Search, Shopping, Pmax, remarketing (YouTube a plus).
  • Familiar with eCom KPIs: ROAS, MER, AOV, CAC, LTV, conversion rate, etc.
  • Bonus: Experience with GMC, GTM, GA4, product feeds.

Client-Facing Skills:

  • You’re comfortable leading calls, pushing back politely, and guiding clients even when performance is bumpy.
  • Strong English communication (written & spoken) and ability to keep things simple and clear.

Analytical & Organised:

  • Can read numbers, spot patterns, and turn them into actionable next steps.
  • Able to juggle multiple accounts, deadlines, and stakeholders without dropping the ball.

Mindset:

  • Proactive, solution-oriented, calm under pressure.
  • You care about ownership – if it’s your account, you’ll do what it takes to make it work.

Video Introduction (5–7 minutes)

With your application, please include a short video covering:

Who you are – quick background, where you’re based, and your experience with eCom + Google Ads.

Account Management Experience –

  • How many accounts you’ve handled at once.
  • Examples of eCom brands you’ve worked on (niches, budgets, results).

Google Ads Performance Stories –

  • A specific example where you helped turn around or scale an account.
  • What was the starting point, what you changed, and the end result (ROAS / revenue / spend).

Client Communication & Firefighting –

  • How you handle tough conversations, drops in performance, or demanding clients.
  • How you keep them calm but also accountable.

Tools & Workflow –

  • Tools you’ve used for project management, comms, and reporting (e.g. Slack, ClickUp, Asana, Loom, GA4, Looker, Sheets).
  • How you stay organised across many accounts.

How You Work with Media Buyers & Strategists –

  • How you like to collaborate internally and keep everyone aligned.

Why This Role –

  • Why you enjoy eCom, Google Ads, and client-facing work.
  • Why you’d be a great fit for this kind of “own the client + own the account” role.

How to Apply

Please submit:

  • Your CV / LinkedIn profile
  • Your video introduction (link)
  • Any case studies or screenshots you’re proud of (optional but encouraged)

title: Técnico em Lubrificação Sênior
description:
Técnico de Lubrificação Sr

Executar e supervisionar planos de lubrificação preventiva, preditiva e corretiva em equipamentos rotativos e estáticos; Definir, avaliar e aplicar os tipos adequados de lubrificantes (graxas, óleos, fluidos especiais), assegurando conformidade com especificações técnicas e recomendações de fabricantes; Monitorar o consumo e desempenho dos lubrificantes, realizando análises de tendência e propondo melhorias de confiabilidade; Realizar coleta de óleo para análise laboratorial (físico-química e ferrográfica), interpretando resultados e recomendando ações corretivas; Implementar e manter rotas de lubrificação em sistemas digitais (CMMS/ERP), garantindo rastreabilidade das atividades; Diagnosticar falhas relacionadas a sistemas de lubrificação e propor soluções para eliminação de recorrências; Orientar e treinar equipes de manutenção quanto às melhores práticas de lubrificação e inspeção de equipamentos; Acompanhar auditorias internas e externas de manutenção, fornecendo suporte técnico sobre processos de lubrificação; Atuar junto às áreas de engenharia de manutenção e confiabilidade no desenvolvimento de novos procedimentos e otimização de intervalos de lubrificação; Zelar pelo cumprimento das normas de segurança, meio ambiente e qualidade na manipulação, armazenamento e descarte de lubrificantes.

Atividades:

Efetua os serviços de verificação de nível e reposição de lubrificantes em equipamentos;

Realiza a inspeção dos equipamentos, relativos à função lubrificação;

Efetua a troca de cargas de lubrificantes, bem como a sua purificação e filtragem;

Lubrifica os pontos de graxa e verifica o funcionamento em sistemas centralizados;

Efetua a lubrificação de correntes, guias, articulações, engrenagens, acoplamentos;

Cumpre a programação periódica de inspeção e lubrificação;

Efetua o levantamento de dados técnicos de equipamentos para elaboração do plano de lubrificação;

Efetua a substituição de elementos filtrantes;

Faz a coleta de amostras de lubrificantes para análise;

Limpeza específica de unidades hidráulicas;

Segrega lubrificantes usados, elementos filtrantes e desengraxantes para descarte;

Segue as instruções de trabalho e procedimentos inerentes à sua função, quando estas existirem;

Executa outras tarefas correlatas às descritas, a critério do superior imediato;

Análise dos laudos dos laboratórios decorrentes das análises dos lubrificantes;

Execução das práticas adequadas para coleta de amostras de lubrificantes;

Garantir a confiabilidade das Unidades Hidráulicas e de lubrificação (elementos filtrantes, nível de contaminação, pontos de coleta de amostras, etc);

Seguir, monitorar e garantir a aplicação dos procedimentos de segurança e meio ambiente da SKF e dos clientes

Garantir que os equipamentos rotativos das unidades fabris dos clientes não quebrem em emergência

Garantir os padrões da qualidade das Normas e Procedimentos ISO

Elaboração e revisão dos planos de Lubrificação Industrial

Requisitos & Competências:

Formação técnica em Mecânica, Mecatrônica, Automação Industrial ou áreas relacionadas.

Conhecimento de lubrificação industrial e seus princípios.

Familiaridade com diferentes tipos de lubrificantes, métodos de aplicação e equipamentos de lubrificação. Habilidade para usar ferramentas e equipamentos de medição, como medidores de viscosidade, analisadores de óleo, entre outros.

Capacidade de interpretar dados de análise de óleo e tomar medidas adequadas com base nos resultados.

Boa comunicação interpessoal e habilidades de trabalho em equipe.

Compromisso com a segurança no ambiente de trabalho.

title: Analista Financeiro Sênior - Temporário
description:
AVISO: "A TMF Group em nenhum momento solicita qualquer tipo de pagamento como parte do nosso processo seletivo, e sempre contatamos nossos candidatos via contas e plataformas corporativas. Se você foi abordado e com solicitação de pagamento, trata-se de uma fraude. Por favor, verifique se a vaga a qual você está interessado, está publicada em nosso site."

SOBRE A TMF GROUP

A TMF Group ajuda seus clientes a operar internacionalmente e 'pertencer' a qualquer lugar do mundo. Nosso trabalho inclui apoiar empresas de todos os tamanhos com serviços como RH e Folha de Pagamento, Contabilidade, Secretariado Corporativo, Governança Global e Administração e Serviços Fiduciários para Finanças Estruturadas, Private Equity e Investimentos Imobiliários. Em 2022 a TMF Group adquiriu a Paraty Capital, uma plataforma brasileira de administração de fundos com foco em fundos de Private Equity, infraestrutura e Venture Capital.

SOBRE O SEU PERFIL

  • Formação: Bacharel completo em Administração, Contabilidade, Economia ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência sólida em contas a receber;
  • Conhecimento em sistemas ERP, preferencialmente TOTVS.

SOBRE A POSIÇÃO

Atuará no cliente em Itu/SP , com contratação por prazo determinado de 6 meses , podendo ser prorrogada.

Contratação para Janeiro de 2026.

Principais responsabilidades:

  • Gerenciar todas as atividades relacionadas a contas a pagar e receber , garantindo precisão e cumprimento dos prazos.
  • Apoiar a implantação do sistema TOTVS , participando da configuração, testes e integração dos processos financeiros.
  • Realizar conciliações, controle de inadimplência e monitoramento dos indicadores da área.
  • Elaborar relatórios gerenciais e análises para suporte à tomada de decisão.
  • Atender auditorias internas e externas;
  • Participar do planejamento orçamentário , projeções financeiras e análise de variações.

O QUE OFERECEMOS

  • Vale Transporte (desconto máximo 2,5%)
  • Assistência Médica e Odontológica - Bradesco
  • Vale Refeição / Alimentação - Flash
  • Seguro de Vida
  • Total Pass
  • Day-off de Aniversário
  • Desconto em cinema - Parceria Cinemark
  • Presente de Nascimento, Casamento e Formatura
  • Massagem no escritório
  • Credencial plena SESC
  • Auxílio Creche
  • Auxilio Home-office
  • Plataforma de cursos e idiomas online

O QUE TEMOS

Impacto Internacional

Nossa presença global em mais de 80 países permite que você influencie a maneira como diversos clientes globais fazem negócios, bem como retribuir as comunidades globais em que operamos.

Seja parte do One TMF

Na TMF Group, nosso pessoal é o que nos torna quem somos. Nossa empresa prospera com o espírito empreendedor de pessoas proativas que combinam entusiasmo com responsabilidade e prestação de contas.

Um mundo de oportunidades

Independentemente de onde você esteja em sua carreira, a TMF Group abre um mundo de oportunidades onde você fará parte de nossa equipe e receberá suporte em sua jornada profissional.

Sendo uma instituição com oportunidades iguais, TMF Group visa diversidade buscando contratar e desenvolver profissionais talentosos, independentemente de sua idade, raça, etnia, gênero, orientação sexual, deficiência, religião e educação. Acreditamos que as diferentes historias, origens, e experiências multiculturais de nossos colaboradores são um poderoso elemento para a criação de um ambiente inclusivo e diversificado onde todos se sintam à vontade em demonstrar sua personalidade única e autentica no trabalho. Trabalhamos fortemente para conseguir criar um ambiente de trabalho que reflita as comunidades que servimos e perspectivas únicas que nossa diversa equipe traz para a nossa companhia e clientes.

title: Gerente de Projetos - PMO Industrial
description:
Somos a Lactalis Brasil !

Fazemos parte do Grupo Lactalis, empresa líder mundial no setor de laticínios, presente em mais de 100 países. O leite está em nossa essência — e é ele que nos conecta às grandes marcas que fazem parte da vida dos brasileiros, como Président, Parmalat, Galbani, Itambé, Batavo, Chamyto, Chambinho, Chandelle, entre outras. Do campo à mesa, cada etapa é conduzida com dedicação, orgulho e amor pelo que fazemos, porque sabemos que nossos produtos carregam a confiança de milhões de famílias.

Acreditamos que o nosso jeito de ser é o que faz a diferença todos os dias. Por meio da Ambição , do Engajamento e da Simplicidade dos nossos 13 mil colaboradores , transformamos desafios em oportunidades e buscamos a excelência em cada fase do processo produtivo. É isso que nos une e nos impulsiona a seguir em frente, sempre com orgulho do que construímos juntos.

Se você também quer fazer parte dessa jornada e ajudar a nutrir o futuro com a gente , candidate-se!

Estamos em busca de uma pessoa para ocupar a posição de Gerente de Projetos – PMO Industrial em São Paulo - SP.

Objetivo do Cargo:

Assegurar a gestão integrada, padronizada e estratégica de todos os projetos industriais da empresa, através da estruturação e liderança do PMO (Project Management Office) , garantindo alinhamento com o plano diretor industrial, metas de investimento (CAPEX/OPEX), segurança, qualidade e performance operacional.

Será responsável por:

Gestão e Governança de Projetos

  • Estabelecer e manter o framework de gestão de projetos industriais , incluindo metodologias, templates, fluxos de aprovação e padrões de relatórios.
  • Supervisionar o portfólio de projetos industriais , priorizando iniciativas conforme ROI, criticidade e disponibilidade orçamentária.
  • Garantir compliance com processos corporativos de engenharia, compras, qualidade, segurança e sustentabilidade.

Planejamento e Controle

  • Consolidar planos mestres de projetos (Master Plan Industrial) com cronogramas integrados, marcos críticos e monitoramento de avanços físicos e financeiros.
  • Estabelecer e acompanhar indicadores de desempenho (KPIs.

Gestão de Equipes e Stakeholders

  • Coordenar gerentes de projeto, engenheiros e analistas de PMO , promovendo cultura de excelência em gestão.
  • Ser o elo entre Diretoria, Engenharia, Operações, Finanças, Marketing e Controle de Gestão traduzindo metas estratégicas em planos executáveis.
  • Apoiar a tomada de decisão executiva com relatórios gerenciais, dashboards e análises de riscos.

Transformação e Melhoria Contínua

  • Promover a padronização digital da gestão de projetos (BIs, MS Project, SAP, software gestão projetos e ferramentas de Indústria 4.0).
  • Identificar e implementar melhores práticas (PMBOK, Lean Project, Agile Industrial) .
  • Conduzir auditorias e lições aprendidas , fortalecendo a governança do ciclo de projetos.

Pré-requisitos/Perfil:

  • Formação em Engenharia (Produção, Mecânica, Elétrica, Automação, Civil ou correlatas).
  • Experiência comprovada em gestão de portfólio e implantação de PMO em ambiente industrial (mínimo 7 anos).
  • Conhecimento sólido em gestão de CAPEX/OPEX e métodos de priorização de projetos.
  • Domínio de ferramentas: MS Project, Power BI, Excel avançado, SAP, Primavera e metodologias PMBOK/PMP.
  • Inglês intermediário/avançado.
  • Certificações PMP, PMO-CP, Lean Six Sigma, ou Agile são diferenciais.
  • Visão estratégica e foco em resultado
  • Capacidade de liderança e influência transversal
  • Alta organização e disciplina na execução
  • Comunicação clara com diferentes níveis hierárquicos
  • Capacidade analítica e tomada de decisão baseada em dados
  • Mentalidade de melhoria contínua e inovação

Java 17 11+8:

-JPA

- TDD

- API design

- Familiarity with the Linux environment

MySql

Python;

AWS (S3, Lambda, ECS, EC2, EventBridge, CloudWatch, DynamoDB, StepFunction, Aurora, GlueJob, ApiGateway, Dynamo);

Kafka;

Health insurance

Dental Plan

All our opportunities are based on these principles. We think of different actions of inclusion and social responsibility, in order to build a TCS that respects individuality. Come to be a TCSer!

title: Scheduling Optimization Engineer
description:
About You

You are a data-driven professional passionate about solving complex scheduling and resource allocation challenges. You thrive on applying advanced optimization techniques to real-world problems, balancing mathematical rigor with practical feasibility. With strong analytical and modeling skills, you design solutions that improve efficiency, reduce costs, and ensure compliance with operational and regulatory requirements.


You bring to Applaudo the following competencies:

  • Advanced knowledge of optimization modeling (integer programming, constraint programming, heuristics/metaheuristics).
  • Proven experience developing and maintaining large-scale scheduling models in applied environments.
  • Ability to incorporate operational rules, contractual agreements, regulatory requirements, and business constraints into model formulations.
  • Hands-on experience with optimization solvers (e.g., Gurobi, CPLEX, OR-Tools).
  • Proficiency in programming languages such as Python, Julia, or C++.
  • Strong understanding of data analysis for planning based on event calendars, service times, passenger volumes, and destination planning.
  • Analytical mindset with strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
  • Excellent communication skills to work effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders.


You will be accountable for the following responsibilities:

  • Develop and maintain advanced optimization models to solve large-scale scheduling problems.
  • Build models that consider event calendars, service times, passenger volumes, and destinations using available data.
  • Integrate operational rules, contractual obligations, regulatory requirements, and business constraints into model formulations.
  • Apply optimization solvers (Gurobi, CPLEX, OR-Tools) to generate feasible, efficient schedules.
  • Collaborate with operations, planning, and technology teams to align outputs with real-world needs.
  • Analyze results to identify cost savings, efficiency improvements, and compliance risks.
  • Continuously refine models to adapt to changes in resource availability, demand patterns, and operational constraints.


Additional Information

Here at Applaudo Studios values as trust, communication, respect, excellence and teamwork are our keys to success. We know we are working with the best and thus treat each other with respect and admiration without asking.


Submit your application today, and don't miss this opportunity to join the Best Digital team in the Region!


We truly appreciate all the hard and outstanding work our team makes every day at Applaudo Studios, and that's why the perks that we offer, are deeply thought and designed as a way to thank them for their commitment and excellence.


Some of our perks and benefits:

  • Celebrations
  • Special discounts*
  • Entertainment area*
  • Modern Workspaces*
  • Great work environment
  • Private medical insurance*


*Benefits may vary according to your location and/or availability. Request further information when applying.

title: PESSOA DESENVOLVEDORA BACKEND (JAVA/KOTLIN) PLENO - REMOTO
description:
Somos o grupo educacional mais diversificado do país. Todos os dias, criamos futuros incríveis através da inovação. Colocamos a mão na massa para tirar as ideias do papel e colocá-las em prática. Enfrentamos desafios com resiliência e nos adaptamos às mudanças constantes.


Por aqui, somos um time e não heróis, guiados pela vontade de fazer a diferença e conectados de um só jeito, o #JeitoCogna. Nossa relação é direta e respeitosa, e o sucesso dos nossos alunos e clientes é o nosso sucesso.


Além disso, valorizamos a diversidade, porque sabemos que quanto mais diverso é o nosso repertório, mais abrangente e inclusivo seremos. Juntos impulsionamos as pessoas a construírem uma melhor versão de si! E aí, bora fazer parte da empresa líder absoluta do segmento educacional? Vem pra Cogna.



Responsabilidades e atribuições


  • - Desenvolver software utilizando as tecnologias Java, Kotlin (Desejável), Framework Spring.
  • - Realizar a integração com bancos de dados, como relacional e não relacionais.
  • - Desejável conhecer sobre Cloud e seus mais variados serviços.
  • - Boas práticas, entender sobre qualidade, SOLID, e Clean Code.
  • - Trabalhar em equipe para garantir a entrega de soluções eficazes
  • - Comunicar-se de forma eficaz para alinhar expectativas e resultados
  • - Demonstrar proatividade na resolução de problemas e busca por melhorias contínuas
  • - Adaptar-se a novos desafios e tecnologias conforme necessário


Requisitos e qualificações


  • - Graduação em Ciência da Computação ou áreas relacionadas
  • - Experiência com desenvolvimento de software e conhecimento em Java, Kotlin, Framework Spring.
  • - Conhecimento em bancos de dados, relacionais e não relacionais.
  • - Habilidade em trabalho em equipe, comunicação eficaz, proatividade, resolução de problemas e adaptabilidade
  • - Cursos relacionados a Desenvolvimento de Software e Certificações na área de Tecnologia são diferenciais
  • - Pós-graduação em Engenharia de Software e participação em eventos e conferências da área são valorizados


O que você pode esperar da gente?

  • Participação nos lucros: resultados com comemoração fazem parte do jeito Cogna.
  • Vale-refeição ou alimentação: num cartão de benefícios flexível.
  • Assistência médica: um abrangente plano de saúde, com inclusão de dependentes e coparticipação.
  • Assistência odontológica: está disponível para manter seu sorriso.


Mas espera, ainda tem mais!

  • Bolsas de estudo de graduação e pós graduação: nossas unidades de ensino para que você e seus dependentes (cônjuge e filhos).
  • Day off no aniversário: você poderá escolher um dia para relaxar e celebrar.
  • Convênio SESC: abre as portas para as inúmeras oportunidades de melhora na qualidade de vida.

title: Full Stack Engineer
description:
We are looking for a high-performing Full Stack Engineer with strong experience in both Python (backend) and React (frontend) to join our client’s distributed engineering team in Brazil. This role is ideal for someone who excels at building clean, scalable APIs and intuitive user interfaces while collaborating with product, design, and engineering stakeholders.


You will be responsible for developing end-to-end features, improving system architecture, and supporting the evolution of a modern tech stack powering mission-critical applications.


Key Responsibilities

  • Design, build, and maintain scalable backend services using Python (FastAPI, Django, or Flask).
  • Develop responsive, user-friendly front-end applications using React, Typescript, and modern UI frameworks.
  • Implement RESTful and/or GraphQL APIs and integrate them with internal and external systems.
  • Work closely with product managers and UX/UI designers to translate requirements into high-quality code.
  • Optimize performance across front-end and back-end components.
  • Manage databases and data models (PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, etc.).
  • Contribute to overall system architecture, code reviews, and engineering best practices.
  • Write automated tests (unit, integration, end-to-end) to maintain code quality.
  • Collaborate in an agile environment with remote teams across Brazil.

Required Skills & Experience

  • 3–7+ years of experience as a Full Stack Engineer or Software Engineer.
  • Strong experience with Python and popular backend frameworks (FastAPI preferred, Flask, Django).
  • Professional experience with React and Typescript (Hooks, Context, Redux, or similar).
  • Experience building and consuming RESTful APIs or GraphQL services.
  • Strong understanding of relational and/or NoSQL databases.
  • Experience deploying applications using cloud services (AWS, GCP, or Azure ).
  • Solid grasp of software architecture, design patterns, and version control (Git).
  • Ability to work independently in a remote environment with clear communication.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, or containerized deployments.
  • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, CircleCI).
  • Exposure to microservices and event-driven architectures.
  • Experience with testing frameworks (PyTest, Jest, Cypress, etc.).
  • Experience working with Brazilian or international distributed engineering teams.

title: Software Architect .NET
description:
Somos a Vortigo - nascemos com o propósito de criar aplicativos mobile para um mundo em constante movimento, mas não paramos por aí. Ampliamos nossa atuação e hoje desenvolvemos softwares para ajudar empresas e startups no processo de transformação digital.

Nosso time é composto por pessoas apaixonadas por desafios gigantes, mudando a experiência dos usuários a nível global.

Estamos espalhados pelo Brasil e pelo mundo, tocando projetos nacionais e internacionais.

Nosso ambiente é descontraído, com uma cultura horizontal, muita troca de conhecimento, reconhecimento e desafios! Tá afim de fazer parte de tudo isso?

Dá uma olhada no que estamos buscando:


Principais Responsabilidades:

- Pesquisar, testar e engajar a adoção e disseminação de novas tecnologias e padrões de solução;

- Colaborar no desenho e implementação de soluções estratégicas para o negócio;

- Participar no desenvolvimento de novos produtos;

- Participar no desenvolvimento de projetos de APIs;

- Definir métodos de integração entre sistemas legados e novos projetos;

- Apoiar no desenvolvimento técnico dos demais integrantes da equipe.


Habilidades Técnicas:

- Experiência sólida em arquitetura de software (Clean Architecture, Domain Driven Design, Microsserviços, Component Driven Design, etc.);

- Domínio de práticas DevOps e CI/CD, com pipelines automatizados para back, front e mobile (Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, Bitrise, App Center);

- Vivência com Cloud (Azure, AWS ou GCP) e provisionamento de infraestrutura como código (IaC);

- Conhecimento em desenvolvimento nativo e multiplataforma (Kotlin, Swift, Flutter, React Native) e web (React.js, Angular, Next.js);

- Experiência em .NET e desenvolvimento backend escalável, com padrões arquiteturais e mensageria (RabbitMQ, Kafka);

- Capacidade de aplicar padrões e boas práticas de engenharia de software (SOLID, Design Patterns, Clean Code);

- Experiência com contêineres e orquestração (Docker, Kubernetes);

- Conhecimento em testes automatizados e estratégias de qualidade (unitários, instrumentados, end-to-end, testes de performance);

- Vivência com monitoramento e observabilidade de sistemas (Application Insights, Jaeger, Firebase Crashlytics, Sentry);

- Conhecimento em segurança de aplicações (OWASP, autenticação multifator, antifraude, segurança mobile/web);

- Atuação com sistemas distribuídos e integração com APIs REST/GraphQL;

- Habilidade em liderar decisões técnicas, avaliar riscos e suportar múltiplas squads em ambientes ágeis.


O que você encontra aqui:

Remote First – Acreditamos no trabalho remoto como um estilo de vida. Nossas vagas são 100% remotas, mas caso queira trabalhar no nosso escritório em Porto Alegre/RS - é só chegar.

Comunidades Técnicas – Um espaço para galera trocar uma ideia, conversar sobre algum assunto específico e, claro, muita troca de conhecimentos.

Cultura de Feedback – Feedbacks estruturados periodicamente, buscando o desenvolvimento contínuo através de um Plano de Desenvolvimento Individual (PDI).

Horário Flexível - Autonomia para fazer a sua própria gestão da jornada de trabalho.

Incentivo ao Idioma - Temos como objetivo internacionalizar cada vez mais a Vortigo e você será parte disso!

Gympass - Plataforma focada na saúde e bem-estar corporativo.

Reembolso de Equipamentos – Valor semestral de reembolso para compra de equipamentos que facilitam sua rotina de trabalho em casa.

title: Senior Data Scientist / ML Engineer
description:
Project Description:

The primary goal of the project is the modernization, maintenance and development of an eCommerce platform for a big US-based retail company, serving millions of omnichannel customers each week.

Solutions are delivered by several Product Teams focused on different domains - Customer, Loyalty, Search and Browse, Data Integration, Cart.

Current overriding priorities are new brands onboarding, re-architecture, database migrations, migration of microservices to a unified cloud-native solution without any disruption to business.


Responsibilities:

  • We are looking for an experienced Data Engineer with Machine Learning expertise and good understanding of search engines, to work on the following:
  • - Design, develop, and optimize semantic and vector-based search solutions leveraging Lucene/Solr and modern embeddings.
  • - Apply machine learning, deep learning, and natural language processing techniques to improve search relevance and ranking.
  • - Develop scalable data pipelines and APIs for indexing, retrieval, and model inference.
  • - Integrate ML models and search capabilities into production systems.
  • - Evaluate, fine-tune, and monitor search performance metrics.
  • - Collaborate with software engineers, data engineers, and product teams to translate business needs into technical implementations.
  • - Stay current with advancements in search technologies, LLMs, and semantic retrieval frameworks.


Mandatory Skills Description:

  • 5+ years of experience in Data Science or Machine Learning Engineering, with a focus on Information Retrieval or Semantic Search.
  • Strong programming experience in both Java and Python (production-level code, not just prototyping).
  • Deep knowledge of Lucene, Apache Solr, or Elasticsearch (indexing, query tuning, analyzers, scoring models).
  • Experience with Vector Databases, Embeddings, and Semantic Search techniques.
  • Strong understanding of NLP techniques (tokenization, embeddings, transformers, etc.).
  • Experience deploying and maintaining ML/search systems in production.
  • Solid understanding of software engineering best practices (CI/CD, testing, version control, code review).


Languages:

  • English: B2 Upper Intermediate

title: Oracle Cloud Field Service consultant
description:
Job Specification: Oracle Cloud Field Service Consultant

Contract Role – Remote

Overview

We are seeking an experienced Oracle Cloud Field Service (OFS) Consultant to support the design, configuration, optimization, and ongoing enhancement of our field service operations. This is a remote contract role suited for someone with strong hands-on expertise in Oracle Field Service Cloud, with additional experience in Oracle Service Cloud (OSvC) and Oracle CPQ being highly desirable.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead the implementation, configuration, and customization of Oracle Field Service Cloud (OFS) to support business workflows, scheduling, routing, and mobile field operations.
  • Collaborate with business stakeholders to gather requirements and translate them into scalable functional and technical solutions.
  • Configure OFS modules including capacity, activity management, work order orchestration, routing plans, and mobility experiences.
  • Integrate OFS with other Oracle cloud applications, especially Oracle Service Cloud , Oracle CPQ , and external systems via REST/SOAP APIs.
  • Perform solution testing, UAT support, documentation, and knowledge transfer to internal teams.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve system issues, ensuring seamless field operations.
  • Recommend best practices and continuous improvements in field service processes.
  • Support deployment activities, including data migration, configuration promotion, and post-go-live stabilization.
  • Work closely with cross-functional teams including service operations, IT, product management, and vendors.

Required Skills & Experience

  • 3–5+ years of hands-on experience implementing and supporting Oracle Field Service Cloud (OFS) .
  • Strong understanding of OFS architecture, configuration frameworks, APIs, message scenarios, routing, and capacity planning.
  • Experience designing workflows, activity types, and policy configurations in OFS.
  • Ability to write and interpret OFS API integrations, business rules, and extensibility scripts.
  • Proven ability to gather requirements and convert them into actionable configuration.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to troubleshoot complex issues.
  • Experience working in Agile or hybrid project delivery environments.
  • Excellent communication, documentation, and stakeholder-management skills.

Desired Skills (Nice to Have)

  • Experience with Oracle Service Cloud (RightNow/OSvC) configuration, workflows, and integrations.
  • Experience with Oracle CPQ (quoting workflows, commerce rules, integrations).
  • Understanding of broader Oracle CX Cloud architecture and integrations.
  • Experience with mobile workforce or field service applications outside Oracle.
  • Knowledge of cloud integration tools (OIC, Boomi, MuleSoft, etc.).

title: Training Coordinator
description:
About NIIT


NIIT is a leading Skills and Talent Development Corporation that is building a manpower pool for global industry requirements. The company, which was set up in 1981 to help the nascent IT industry overcome its human resource challenges, today ranks among the world’s leading training companies owing to its vast, yet comprehensive array of talent development programs. With a footprint across 40 nations, NIIT offers training and development solutions to Individuals, Enterprises, and Institutions.


Link to our LinkedIn Page -

Link to our website -

Position: Training Coordinator


We are looking for our next training operations coordinator. This role is part of the Operations team and supports NIIT’s customer(s) in Frankfurt.

to deliver outstanding service.

We all work together on a common project with part of the team based in India.

As a training operations coordinator, you will be reporting to the training operations manager.

You will be the key contact point for all local stakeholders, coordinating training session delivery. You will master and oversee all activities within the service.

You will work closely and in partnership with the customer’s learning delivery team.


Roles & Responsibility:


  • Analyze the training needs provided by the Client and determine the number of sessions needed to train the overall number of trainees according to courses and per site,
  • Initiate and manage requests for session creation, modification, completion, and cancellation where required,
  • Organize the training sessions according to trainees’ expectations and availability and ensure their proper execution,
  • Calibrate and coordinate with the Indian team for any changes/updates in the training event/program,
  • Support completion of training activities by following up for attendance and invoice if required,
  • Follow and ensure adherence to the workflow and processes using the CRM tool
  • Ensure Learner Support Level 2


Experience & Skill:


  • 2 to 4 years of experience in learning delivery management and/or operations,
  • Exposure to an international work environment
  • High-level understanding of the training landscape
  • Customer service-oriented posture is a must
  • Team player
  • Ability to communicate clearly and concise thoughts
  • Attention to detail, structured and organized, capable of prioritizing activities
  • Knowledge of Salesforce or any other CRM
  • Knowledge of Cornerstone or any other LMS is an added advantage
  • Fluent in English is a mandatory requirement
  • Proficient in MS Office, Excel, SharePoint


NIIT is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic.

title: Especialista Salesforce
description:
Sobre a Empresa


Há mais de 20 anos mercado, somos uma consultoria estratégica de Inovação e Transformação Digital. Nossa especialidade é impulsionar as demandas de nossos clientes, integrando processos, pessoas e tecnologia de alta performance.


Sobre o Cargo: Especialista Salesforce


Responsabilidades:

Perfil de liderança

Desenvolver soluções customizadas na plataforma Salesforce utilizando Apex, LWC (Lightning Web Components), Visualforce e triggers.

Implementar integrações com sistemas externos via APIs REST/SOAP.

Criar automações avançadas, componentes reutilizáveis e testes unitários com alta cobertura.

Otimizar queries e gerenciar limites da plataforma (governor limits).

Colaborar com times funcionais e administradores para entrega de soluções técnicas aderentes aos requisitos de negócio.

Apoiar a gestão do ciclo de vida de desenvolvimento (DevOps), incluindo controle de versões e deploys com ferramentas como SFDX, Git e pipelines de CI/CD


Requisitos:

Domínio de todas as etapas do ciclo no Salesforce

Experiência prévia em projetos Salesforce (atuando como desenvolvedor).

Vivência em ambientes ágeis (Scrum/Kanban) e em squads multidisciplinares.

Experiência prática com integrações complexas e grandes volumes de dados.


Desejável experiência em projetos de implementação de soluções escaláveis em empresas de médio e grande porte.



Modelo de trabalho:

100% remoto

Role Description

This is a full-time, on-site Chief Financial Officer (CFO) role located in Hayward, CA.   • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, or related field; CPA or MBA is preferred
  • Experience in the moving or logistics industry is a plus
  • Ability to work effectively in an on-site, collaborative setting

title: Consultor de Investimentos WS - Parceiros XP | Remoto
description:
Essa oportunidade é para consultor de investimento nas consultorias Wealth Service parceiras da rede XP, que tem a missão de ajudar o brasileiro a investir melhor. São times apaixonados por relacionamento com cliente, aprofundamento técnico sobre alocação de recursos e prospecção de novos negócios.


Principais Responsabilidades

  • Prospecção de novos clientes;
  • Atuação na consultoria de investimentos, sendo responsável por orientar o cliente final na gestão de patrimônio;
  • Elaboração de portfólio de investimentos em linha com o perfil e objetivo dos clientes;
  • Análise de alocações externas e elaboração de estudos comparativos exclusivos, identificando oportunidades e apresentando de forma objetiva;
  • Acompanhamento de tendências de mercado, se mantendo sempre informado sobre atualidades do cenário econômico e acontecimentos relevantes.


Informações Importantes

  • Trabalho remoto em diversas praças do país


Pré-Requisito

  • Perfil comercial e fortes habilidades de comunicação;
  • Alto nível de intensidade e disciplina;
  • Conhecimento sobre cenário econômico atual;
  • Experiência prévia em instituições financeiras;
  • Certificação CEA, CPF, CFA e/ou CGA (aceitável com prova agendada)


Você pode ter destaque se:

  • Possuir carteira de clientes para prospecção;
  • Ter base de clientes já estabelecida é um grande diferencial;
  • Conhecimentos sobre produtos financeiros;
  • Noções básicas de macroeconomia e atualidades.

title: Senior Backend (Typescript) Engineer
description:
Would you like to partake in technical challenges and contribute to taking our product to market? Are you ready to meet and exceed ambitious targets in a rapid-paced, results-driven startup environment? Then keep reading!


Yes, tell me more…

fullinfo is a startup B2B data services software company.

We are building an un-paralleled data collection pipeline which is being deployed on AWS and written in Go and Typescript. With a focus on innovation, quality, and accessibility, we are developing a one-stop lead generator platform.

The Customer facing part of the solution is a Typescript and GraphQL based web application. Deployed on AWS as well. Serverless paradigm is being applied: Most of our code is running as AWS’s Lambda’s. AWS infrastructure is managed by applying Terraform.


We’re looking for a Senior Backend (Typescript) Engineer to join on an initial 12-month B2B contract basis. The ideal candidate will be comfortable with AWS (Serverless architecture), Typescript and willing to pick up new technologies such as Go. A language agnostic attitude towards software engineering is considered as a pro.



Responsibilities:

  • You are responsible for the quality of our data processing pipeline
  • Creating and reviewing processes that affect speed and cost efficiency
  • Ensuring all steps in our data pipeline are integrated seamlessly
  • Optimising the product for continuous scalability
  • Delivering ongoing process improvement
  • Collaborate with frontend engineers, CTO and principle software engineer
  • Meet aggressive development timelines.
  • Own complex tasks from concept to completion, ensuring the highest standards of quality under pressure.


Requirements:

  • A Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science or related field
  • A minimum of 5 years relevant experience working in Backend Software Engineering
  • Experience using Typescript for Backend Development
  • Experience with other programming languages like Python, Java, C++
  • Business Proficiency in English is essential
  • Meticulous attention to detail.
  • Proven ability to thrive in a high-pressure, deadline-driven environment.
  • Startup mentality – understands the dedication it takes to thrive in a startup environment.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills. Business-level English required.
  • A strong history of delivering high-quality, high-impact results with minimal supervision.


The successful candidate will…

  • Be comfortable working with the frontend if required
  • Have a desire to work on different features within our solution, and take a generalist role
  • Possess the ability to familiarize yourself with our product quickly to generate new ideas, reflect on our existing features and think ahead
  • Be experienced with or passionate about guiding other developers
  • Take on a proactive, hands-on approach
  • Be a proactive, results-oriented professional who excels when challenged.


What can you expect from us?

  • To shape the company from the ground up – join our team as a pioneer and help us carve our way forward. This means taking on significant ownership and being accountable for delivering high-impact results quickly.
  • Together we’ll take our product to market – how cool would it be to celebrate together as part of our highly motivated team?
  • A startup environment that is passionate about quality, problem solving and building beautiful software. Be prepared for a very fast-paced environment where priorities can shift quickly to meet market and business demands.


Our passion stems from our shared values and mission. With that said, our culture is built on two major aspects:

Quality: At fullinfo we let the quality of our product speak for itself. We are passionate about building beautiful software and always raising the bar on quality.

Problem Solving: We foster innovation and novel approaches to problem solving, while keeping user needs at front of mind.
