title: JDE Developer
description:
We are HCLTech, one of the world’s largest and fastest growing technology and DSA companies with over 227,000 professionals across 60 countries, driving progress through industry-leading capabilities focused on Digital, Engineering and Cloud.


The driving force behind this work, our people, is a diverse, creative and passionate audience that enables us to continually raise the bar for excellence in our services. We strive to empower each of our professionals to achieve their best, while also striving to help them find their daily inspiration and become the best version of themselves.


JDE Developer

Position Summary:

The JDE Developer is responsible for designing and implementing JDE enhancements, reports, and interfaces programs utilizing the JDE developer toolkit owned by the GTS Corporate Applications team. This position serves as a Subject Matter Expert (SME) resource for JD Enterprise One (JDE), supporting processes, and implementing improvements. The JDE Developer ensures appropriate controls are in place and integrates data for decision makers and business owners to support IT, Compliance, project, and vendor management activities. The JDE Developer will be focused on the Global Systems Implementation , initially on the LatAm and UK/EMEA regions.


Responsibilities:

JDE Developer responsibilities include:

• Serve as a subject matter expert developer for JD Edwards Enterprise One (JDE) associated with functionality, content, processes, and procedures.

• Gather business requirements and implement a global standard design for the Global Systems Implementation of JDE enhancements, reports, and interfaces with other Gallagher applications

• Assist with the design and implementation of operational and system enhancements to ensure production capabilities are both effective and efficient

• Ensure JDE development deliverables are completed on time and bug free

• Based on detailed requirements, analyze business needs, create appropriate functional and technical designs, develop the programs, and perform testing to ensure quality of the deliverables.

• Ensure JDE programs are compliant with IT Policy. Build plans to enforce compliance with IT policy and standard user management processes.


Skills Required:

• Technical experience of JD Edwards Enterprise One 9.1 or higher, including application configuration and development

• Experience with JDE Localization implementations, preferably for LatAm countries

• Strong financial applications, analysis and issue resolution (trouble shooting) skills

• Experience working with fellow team members and third party vendors to integrate with SaaS solutions

• Working "hands-on" knowledge of Software Development Life Cycle and project management methodologies

• Financial & Business acumen (working knowledge) and awareness of management and analysis processes

• Strong PC skills, including experience using MS Office Products, especially Excel

• Excellent organization skills, and verbal and written communication skills

• Experience working in large enterprises with domestic and international locations

• Experience working with off-shore or remote development/support teams

• Advanced in Spanish/Advanced English


Desired:

• Bachelor’s Degree in Business, Information Technology, Engineering or related field

• Technology project support experience

• Understanding of integration with Identity Management solutions

• Moderate level proficiency with Microsoft Visio or Lucid

• Intermediate SQL query skills


Work Traits:

• Demonstrated ability to prioritize and manage multiple tasks simultaneously

• Ability to work at a fast pace and cope with conflicting deadlines

• Proven ability to deliver excellent customer service

• Good analytical and problem solving skills

• Strong attention to detail


Equality & Opportunity for All

Representing 165 nationalities worldwide, we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all applicants and employees without regard to race, religion, sex, color, age, national origin, pregnancy, sexual orientation, disability or genetic information, or any other protected classification, in accordance with federal, state and/or local laws


At HCLTech, we don’t just offer jobs — we offer journeys. Join a global team where your work drives innovation, your ideas matter, and your growth is supported every step of the way.


Why Choose HCLTech?

  • Be part of a purpose-led organization with a global footprint
  • Collaborate with diverse teams across borders
  • Work on cutting-edge technologies in enterprise integration
  • Enjoy career mobility, continuous learning, and a culture of inclusion

title: Key Account Manager
description:
Job Title: VIP Account Manager

Location: Brazil -Remote


************ *Note - PLEASE ONLY APPLY IF YOU HAVE IGAMING EXPERIENCE ******************


Our client, a well-known Brazilian gambling operator, is looking for a motivated VIP Account Manager to assist in managing and growing the VIP customer segment to help and assist the current VIP team in place.


This role will focus on building strong client relationships, supporting engagement strategies, and helping improve the overall VIP experience. It’s a great opportunity for someone with account management experience who wants to develop their skills in a dynamic industry.


Key Responsibilities:


  • Assist in identifying and onboarding new VIP clients through prospecting and networking.


  • Support the management of VIP client relationships, ensuring high levels of satisfaction.


  • Help execute engagement and retention strategies to increase player loyalty.


  • Work closely with senior team members to design and implement and improve VIP incentives, promotions, and personalized offers.


  • Monitor key performance metrics such as betting volume, customer acquisition cost (CAC), retention rates, and customer lifetime value (LTV).


  • Assist in preparing reports on VIP performance and account development.


  • Ensure compliance with responsible gaming and company policies.



Skills & Qualifications :


  • Experience in account management, sales, or customer service, preferably in the betting or online gaming industry.


  • A wallet or existing player base would be incredibly valuable and sought after.


  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills to build client relationships.


  • Basic knowledge of sports betting and online casino market is a plus.


  • Comfortable working with data and reports to understand customer behavior.


  • Proficiency in MS Office and CRM tools.


  • Ability to work flexible hours when needed.


This role is ideal for someone eager to grow in VIP management, with the opportunity to learn from experienced professionals in the field and business.

title: SAP ECC ABAP
description:
Venha para uma das maiores empresas de Serviços IT do mundo!! Aqui você pode transformar sua carreira!


Por que fazer parte da TCS? Aqui na TCS acreditamos que as pessoas fazem a diferença, por isso vivemos uma cultura de aprendizado ilimitado cheio de oportunidades de melhorias e desenvolvimento mútuo. O cenário ideal para expandir ideias através das ferramentas certas, contribuindo para nosso sucesso num ambiente colaborativo.


Procuramos SAP ABAP Consultant que queira aprender e transformar sua carreira.


Temos alguns requisitos:


  • Fluência em inglês é mandatória para uma comunicação eficaz entre equipes globais e stakeholders.
  • Forte desenvolvimento ABAP em objetos RICEF: Relatórios (ALV), Interfaces (IDoc/BAPI/CPI-REST), Conversões (programas LTMC/LSMW/ABAP), Melhorias (BADI/Exits/Enh. Spots) e Formulários (SmartForms/Adobe).
  • ABAP orientado a objetos (OO), modularização, visualizações CDS, conceitos básicos de AMDP, desenvolvimento de serviços BOPF/Fiori OData; sólida depuração e ajuste de desempenho (SQL trace/ST05, SAT/SE30, análise de tempo de execução).
  • Experiência em todo o ciclo de vida: design técnico, construção, testes unitários, revisão de código, gerenciamento de transporte (ChaRM/SolMan) e resolução de defeitos em SIT/UAT/hipercare.
  • Sólido conhecimento de modelos de dados SD/MM/FI e pontos de integração; capacidade de traduzir especificações funcionais em soluções técnicas escaláveis e seguir padrões de codificação.



Principais Responsabilidades:


  • Entregar desenvolvimentos e integrações ABAP de alta qualidade, suportando módulos SAP e necessidades de localização;
  • Fornecer suporte e melhorias na produção.
  • Participar de workshops com equipes funcionais; criar Documentos de Design Técnico (TDD), estimativas e planos de construção.
  • Desenvolver e manter objetos RICEF em conformidade com os padrões de nomenclatura, desempenho e segurança; garantir a reutilização e o tratamento/registro de erros adequado.
  • Construir e expor interfaces via IDoc/BAPI/OData/REST; trabalhar com CPI/PI para mapeamentos de middleware e tratamento de erros.
  • Projetar saídas e formulários: SmartForms/Adobe (S/4 Output Management/BRFplus); lidar com código de barras/QR code e arquivamento em PDF.
  • Implementar melhorias via BADIs/Exits e eventos CDS/BOPF; criar frameworks de AIF/erro, trabalhos em segundo plano e controles de spool/impressão.
  • Realizar testes unitários, criar evidências de teste, oferecer suporte a SIT/UAT e resolver defeitos; manter a rastreabilidade em relação aos requisitos.
  • Otimizar o desempenho usando rastreamento SQL e análise de tempo de execução; Refatorar código personalizado para prontidão S/4HANA (Sintático/Funcional).
  • Gerenciar transportes entre ambientes; cumprir os padrões do Solution Manager/ChaRM e de documentação; oferecer suporte ao hypercare e ao KT para dar suporte às equipes.


O que oferecemos?


Benefícios TCS – Brasil:

  • Plano de Saúde
  • Plano Odontológico
  • Seguro de Vida
  • Vale Transporte
  • Vale Refeição/Alimentação
  • Auxílio Creche
  • Gympass
  • TCS Cares – 0800 gratuito que fornece assistência psicológica (24 hrs/dia), jurídica, social e financeira aos associados
  • Parceria com SESC
  • Reembolso de Certificações
  • Portal de aprendizagem gratuito da TCS – cursos online e treinamentos ao vivo
  • Oportunidade de experiência internacional
  • Parceria de Descontos com Universidades e Escolas de Idiomas
  • Bring Your Buddy – Ao indicar pessoas você se torna elegível a receber um bônus para cada contratação
  • TCS Gems – Reconhecimento por performance
  • Xcelerate – Plataforma de carreira com mentoria gratuita


Na TATA Consultancy Services promovemos uma cultura inclusiva, trabalhamos sempre pela equidade. Isso se aplica em Gênero, Pessoas com Deficiência, LGBTQIA+, Religião, Raça, Etnia, ou seja, todas as nossas oportunidades são trabalhadas com esses princípios. Pensamos em ações diversas de inclusão e de responsabilidade social, a fim de construir uma TCS que respeita a individualidade. Seja um TCSer!

title: Sr Python Data Engineer
description:
Senior Python Data Engineer

About the Project


Responsibilities

  • Design, build, and maintain high-performance data processing pipelines using Python libraries (Pandas, Polars).
  • Develop and expose RESTful APIs using FastAPI or similar frameworks.
  • Consume and process normalized Parquet files from multiple upstream sources to generate dynamic Excel reports.
  • Contribute to a spec-driven development workflow (using GitHub Copilot, Claude, etc.) to scaffold and generate API/data pipeline code.
  • Optimize report generation logic for speed and scalability, currently targeting sub-20 second response times.
  • Integrate with messaging and storage mechanisms (e.g., Service Bus, Storage Accounts).
  • Collaborate on infrastructure-as-code automation using Bicep (or similar IaC tools).
  • Participate in design discussions for future migration to Snowflake and/or a data lake architecture.
  • Contribute to CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions.


Required Skills and Experience

  • Strong proficiency in Python for data processing (must have expertise in Pandas, nice to have: Polars, openpyxl).
  • Experience building backend services or APIs using frameworks like FastAPI.
  • Solid understanding of data modeling principles (Star Schema) and handling normalized datasets.
  • Familiarity with enterprise messaging patterns and data integration from various sources (API-based and file-based).
  • Experience working with GitHub and CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions or similar).
  • Infrastructure-as-Code experience with Bicep or comparable tools (Terraform, AWS CDK).
  • Comfort with spec-driven development and leveraging AI tools like GitHub Copilot for scaffolding.


Softensity is an equal-opportunity employer. All qualified applicants are considered without regard to gender, identity, or personal background.

title: Direct Response Video Editor for 8-Figure DTC Brand
description:
Direct Response Video Editor (Remote - Brazil Preferred)


$1,200-$1,400 USD/month + $250+ Monthly Performance Bonuses


We're an 8-figure DTC beauty & wellness brand generating $1M+ in monthly revenue through high-volume, high-converting video advertising. We need an elite video editor who understands direct response mechanics and can produce scroll-stopping ads at scale.


Your work will directly drive sales across Meta, YouTube, and emerging platforms—with immediate feedback from millions of impressions monthly.


What You'll Actually Do


High-Volume Ad Production (40-60 ads/month): Transform raw creator footage, UGC clips, and b-roll into persuasive short-form ads (15-90 seconds) and VSLs that convert cold traffic into buyers. You'll work across multiple products and funnels simultaneously.


Master Direct Response Mechanics:

  • Craft hooks that stop thumbs in the first 3 seconds (pattern interrupts, bold claims, visual glitches)
  • Deploy engagement disruptors: kinetic typography, callout graphics, progress bars, emoji reactions
  • Optimize pacing for platform algorithms (Meta 9:16, YouTube Shorts)
  • A/B test visual approaches based on performance data


Post-Production Excellence Color grading, sound design, motion graphics, and seamless transitions using Premiere Pro, After Effects, or DaVinci Resolve. Your edits should feel polished but authentic—not overproduced.


Rapid Iteration & Testing Partner with our Creative Strategist to test new concepts weekly. Expect fast feedback cycles and the need to pivot based on real-time campaign data. Speed + quality = your competitive advantage here.


AI-Enhanced Workflow Leverage tools like Descript, Runway, and AI caption generators to maximize output without sacrificing quality. We value efficiency and smart automation.


Top Fits Will Have:

  • Strong level of fluent English fluency (hard requirement)
  • 2+ years editing for DTC/eCommerce brands (beauty, health, or supplements ideal)
  • Portfolio demonstrating direct response ads that drove conversions (show us your winners)
  • Expert-level proficiency in Premiere Pro or DaVinci Resolve + After Effects
  • Deep understanding of Meta/YouTube Shorts specs and algorithm-friendly editing patterns
  • Native fluency with UGC aesthetics (raw, authentic, relatable) vs. polished brand content
  • Proven ability to produce 8-12 ads per week without compromising quality
  • Ability to think critically and recommend new approaches, ad formats, and tools (outside the box)


Bonus Points:

  • Experience editing short-form VSLs (2-3+ minutes) or long-form VSLs (25+ minutes)
  • Motion design skills (After Effects, Cinema 4D)
  • Understanding of direct response copywriting principles
  • Familiarity with CapCut, Descript, or AI editing tools
  • Portuguese + English fluency


Non-Negotiables:

  • Fast turnaround times (24-48 hour revisions)
  • Self-directed work ethic in a remote environment
  • Obsessive attention to detail
  • Ego-free collaboration and receptiveness to feedback



Why Top Editors Choose Us:


Transparent Compensation Base salary + monthly performance bonuses tied to ad performance metrics. Top performers earn 20-30% above base.


Career Growth Path Start as Senior Editor → Lead Editor → Creative Director as we scale. We promote from within.


See Your Impact Daily Direct access to campaign metrics. You'll know exactly which of your ads are crushing it (and which aren't).

title: Consultor SAP MM Sr
description:
Consultor SAP MM Sênior

Remoto | PJ | 4 meses (prorrogável)


Requisitos:

  • Experiência comprovada com mensageria de NF-e e automação de entrada de notas fiscais .
  • Conhecimentos sólidos em SAP MM , Localização Brasil , J1BTAX .
  • Vivência em projetos de implementação de sistemas SAP .
  • Boas noções técnicas em transações SAP e capacidade de realizar debug funcional .

Responsabilidades:

  • Implementação de solução de mensageria de NF-e (saída).

  • Execução de configurações da solução, testes unitários, testes integrados, treinamento e suporte a área de negócio nos projetos.

Highlight Job of the Week!


Job Title: Administrative Assistant


Pay Rate LinkedIn style:


Part-Time Monthly Rates : $800 - $1,280 (based on 20 hours per week schedule)

Full-Time Monthly Rates : $1,600 - $2,560 (based on 40 hours per week schedule)


The monthly salary range posted is stipulated as an average monthly income. However, all jobs at Virtual Latinos are hourly-based, and payments are calculated on the number of hours a person works daily. We pay our Virtual Professionals every 2 weeks through third-party platforms. The hourly rate range of the position is $10- $16 depending on experience. Once a rate has been offered to you, it is non-negotiable.



Work Schedule:


The work schedule will vary depending on the job position that you will apply for as it will be based on the schedule requested by the client. All our clients are in the U.S. and work schedules will be in the U.S. time zone.


Job Summary:


The Administrative Assistant will be responsible for providing administrative and customer service support, helping to coordinate schedules, maintain communication with internal and external teams, and manage tasks in a dynamic environment. The ideal candidate will be tech-savvy, detail-oriented, and proactive, supporting the client in a variety of tasks to ensure smooth daily operations.


Job Tasks:


  • Calendar Management: Organize schedules, book meetings, and keep calendars up to date.
  • Email Management: Review, prioritize, and organize emails professionally.
  • Task Tracking: Monitor tasks and deadlines using project management tools.
  • Documentation: Prepare reports, take meeting notes, and maintain organized digital files.
  • Customer Support: Communicate with clients and teams via email, chat, and phone as needed.
  • Research Assistance: Support with gathering information and summarizing findings when required.
  • General Admin: Assist with ad-hoc administrative and support tasks as assigned.


Qualifications:


  • 1 year of related experience and/or a related degree.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.
  • Ability to excel in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong organizational abilities.
  • Meticulous attention to detail.
  • Collaborative team spirit.
  • Commitment to confidentiality.
  • A quiet, private workspace.
  • Must be at least 21 years old.


Software:

  • WhatsApp
  • Asana
  • Miro
  • Canva
  • AI tools (flexible)
  • Open to other tools as needed


Languages:


  • English mandatory
  • Portuguese mandatory

title: Data Engineer
description:
We are seeking a highly skilled Python Data Engineer with an AI/ML focus to join our client’s growing data & analytics team in Brazil. This role is ideal for someone who loves building scalable data pipelines, operationalizing machine learning workflows, and partnering closely with data scientists to bring models into production.


You will design, develop, and maintain data infrastructure that powers AI-driven insights across the organization, including data models and pipelines that run through Snowflake . This is a fully remote position working with cross-functional product, engineering, and analytics teams.


Key Responsibilities

  • Build, optimize, and maintain ETL/ELT pipelines using Python, modern data engineering frameworks, and Snowflake as a central data warehouse.
  • Architect and manage data workflows , ensuring accuracy, scalability, and reliability.
  • Work closely with data scientists to deploy, monitor, and tune machine learning models .
  • Develop feature engineering pipelines , preprocessing workflows, and model-serving APIs.
  • Integrate data from various sources (APIs, databases, cloud storage, streaming platforms).
  • Implement MLOps best practices including versioning, CI/CD for ML, and automated retraining workflows.
  • Optimize data storage, compute usage, and performance within Snowflake and cloud-native tools (AWS, GCP, or Azure).
  • Create and maintain documentation, data catalogs, and operational guides.
  • Monitor data system performance and recommend improvements.

Required Skills & Experience

  • 3–7+ years of experience as a Data Engineer , Python Engineer , or similar backend/data role.
  • Strong proficiency in Python , including building production-grade data pipelines.
  • Experience with Snowflake —data modeling, Snowpipe, tasks, streams, stored procedures, and performance optimization.
  • Experience with AI/ML workflows : feature engineering, inference pipelines, or deploying models.
  • Proficiency in SQL and relational databases (PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQL Server).
  • Hands-on experience with at least one cloud platform (AWS , GCP , or Azure ).
  • Experience using data orchestration tools like Airflow , Prefect , or Dagster .
  • Familiarity with MLOps tools such as MLflow, Kubeflow, SageMaker, Vertex AI , or similar.
  • Strong understanding of data modeling, data warehousing, and distributed systems.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Spark , Databricks , or other big-data processing tools.
  • Experience ingesting and transforming data at scale on Snowflake , including optimization of virtual warehouses.
  • Familiarity with Kafka , Kinesis , or other streaming platforms.
  • Understanding of CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins, etc.).
  • Exposure to deep learning frameworks (TensorFlow, PyTorch).
  • Experience working with Brazilian clients or LATAM distributed engineering teams.

You will design, develop, and maintain data infrastructure that powers AI-driven insights across the organization, including data models and pipelines that run through Snowflake . This is a fully remote position working with cross-functional product, engineering, and analytics teams.


Key Responsibilities

  • Build, optimize, and maintain ETL/ELT pipelines using Python, modern data engineering frameworks, and Snowflake as a central data warehouse.
  • Architect and manage data workflows , ensuring accuracy, scalability, and reliability.
  • Work closely with data scientists to deploy, monitor, and tune machine learning models .
  • Develop feature engineering pipelines , preprocessing workflows, and model-serving APIs.
  • Integrate data from various sources (APIs, databases, cloud storage, streaming platforms).
  • Implement MLOps best practices including versioning, CI/CD for ML, and automated retraining workflows.
  • Optimize data storage, compute usage, and performance within Snowflake and cloud-native tools (AWS, GCP, or Azure).
  • Create and maintain documentation, data catalogs, and operational guides.
  • Monitor data system performance and recommend improvements.

Required Skills & Experience

  • 3–7+ years of experience as a Data Engineer , Python Engineer , or similar backend/data role.
  • Strong proficiency in Python , including building production-grade data pipelines.
  • Experience with Snowflake —data modeling, Snowpipe, tasks, streams, stored procedures, and performance optimization.
  • Experience with AI/ML workflows : feature engineering, inference pipelines, or deploying models.
  • Proficiency in SQL and relational databases (PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQL Server).
  • Hands-on experience with at least one cloud platform (AWS , GCP , or Azure ).
  • Experience using data orchestration tools like Airflow , Prefect , or Dagster .
  • Familiarity with MLOps tools such as MLflow, Kubeflow, SageMaker, Vertex AI , or similar.
  • Strong understanding of data modeling, data warehousing, and distributed systems.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Spark , Databricks , or other big-data processing tools.
  • Experience ingesting and transforming data at scale on Snowflake , including optimization of virtual warehouses.
  • Familiarity with Kafka , Kinesis , or other streaming platforms.
  • Understanding of CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins, etc.).
  • Exposure to deep learning frameworks (TensorFlow, PyTorch).
  • Experience working with Brazilian clients or LATAM distributed engineering teams.

title: College-Level Chemistry Tutor
description:
We are looking for tutors to solve college-level Chemistry questions in English. These questions are submitted by students, who expect a response in less than 24 hours.


Tutors in this project work in freelance mode and can decide the number of hours they wish to work.


Do you prefer to work in the morning, in the evening, for a few hours or many hours? The choice is yours. You can log in at any time to help students. In addition, you can work from anywhere, as long as you have a computer with a reliable Internet connection.


We need tutors who can start immediately!


Characteristics


Payment in dollars.

Type of contract: freelance/self-employed.

Schedule: Flexible, free choice

Start: Immediate

Duration: Indefinite


Requirements


  • Ability to solve university-level questions in at least one of the following subjects:
  • General Chemistry
  • Organic Chemistry
  • Student or graduate of a university course whose curriculum includes at least one of the subjects listed in the previous point.
  • Computer with an Internet connection.
  • No criminal record.


About LatinHire


Founded in 2003, LatinHire is a company specialising in managing teams of experts for distance learning institutions. Its clients include some of the world's most prestigious education startups.

title: Commercial Account Manager
description:
About WSO2:

Founded in 2005, WSO2 is the largest independent software vendor providing open source API management, integration, and identity and access management (IAM) to thousands of enterprises in over 90 countries. WSO2's products and platforms—including our next-gen internal developer platform, Choreo—empower organizations to leverage the full potential of artificial intelligence and APIs for securely delivering the next generation of AI-enabled digital services and applications. Our open source, AI-driven, API-first approach frees developers and architects from vendor lock-in and enables rapid digital product creation. Recognized as leaders by industry analysts, WSO2 has more than 800 employees worldwide with offices in Australia, Brazil, Germany, India, Sri Lanka, the UAE, the UK, and the US, with over USD100M in annual recurring revenue. Visit to learn more.

About the Role:

The Commercial Account Executive is responsible for managing and growing existing customer accounts and leveraging new business opportunities. This role requires a strong understanding of customer needs, complex sales projects, the ability to build and maintain long-term relationships, and a proven track record of exceeding sales targets.

Key Responsibilities:

Account Management:

  • Develop and execute account plans to achieve revenue growth and customer satisfaction goals.
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with key decision-makers at existing customer accounts. Ensure customer satisfaction and retention.
  • Proactively identify and pursue new business opportunities within existing accounts.
  • Conduct regular account reviews and provide insightful business reviews to customers.
  • Work closely with other departments (including pre-sales, product, legal, and marketing) to support customer success.

Sales and Revenue:

  • Achieve and exceed assigned sales quotas and revenue targets.
  • Drive client retention, renewals, upsells, and cross-sells.
  • Negotiate and close deals effectively.
  • Manage the entire sales cycle from lead qualification to contract negotiation and customer onboarding.
  • Contribute to the development of sales strategies and best practices.
  • Gather market intelligence, developments, and competitor activities and share insights with the sales team.

Qualifications and Skills:

  • Proven track record of success in a sales role, preferably in the software industry.
  • Experience with long sales cycles, request for proposals, and public tenders.
  • Strong understanding of the software development lifecycle and enterprise IT environments.
  • Experience with open source software, API management, and IAM technologies.
  • Excellent communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills.
  • Strong negotiation and closing skills.
  • Ability to build and maintain strong customer relationships.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Proficiency in CRM systems (e.g., Salesforce) and other sales tools.
  • Native portuguese speaker, fluent in English (oral and written).
  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent preferred.

In Addition to a Competitive Compensation Package, WSO2 Offers:

  • A work culture and environment where we value both hard work AND flexibility.
  • A flexible vacation/leave plan that fits your needs.
  • Health, dental, and life insurance for you and your family.
  • An opportunity to work with cutting-edge technologies.
  • An opportunity for professional growth and development.
  • A fully remote position with frequent short travel.

Diversity Drives Innovation:

We’ve built our business on a commitment to diversity and inclusion. We believe it’s important to foster an environment that values and respects each individual’s strengths, perspectives, and ideas. Doing so not only drives innovation; it also ensures that we can create superior experiences for our customers, partners, and employees worldwide. We value the diversity of our team regardless of race, ethnicity, religion, gender, age, national origin, disability, sexual orientation, or veteran or marital status, and we do not tolerate any form of discrimination.

description:
O QUE VOCÊ VAI FAZER:

  • Realizar o atendimento aos ambientes dos clientes Cloud por meio dos canais TOTVS, solucionando demandas de baixa complexidade relacionadas à infraestrutura;
  • Revisar e classificar os tickets, quando necessário, conforme a categoria adequada e os processos definidos, garantindo o cumprimento das metas estabelecidas;
  • Registrar as solicitações dos clientes com todas as evidências e detalhes necessários, assegurando a rastreabilidade e a comunicação entre os envolvidos;
  • Analisar os tickets abertos pelos clientes, reclassificando ou categorizando conforme os procedimentos documentados pela área, para correta adequação da demanda;
  • Fornecer atualizações sobre o andamento das solicitações, quando solicitado, por meio dos canais de atendimento disponíveis (telefone, e-mail ou sistema);
  • Escalonar para o próximo nível as solicitações ou incidentes não resolvidos, após o esgotamento das possibilidades de solução dentro do prazo estimado pela Coordenação, registrando detalhadamente as ações executadas e os resultados obtidos;
  • Contribuir para o atingimento dos indicadores individuais (produtividade, satisfação do cliente, entre outros) e das metas da área, seguindo os procedimentos e padrões estabelecidos para o ambiente Cloud;
  • Alertar a coordenação e a liderança sobre possíveis riscos ou situações críticas em clientes, registrando os tickets conforme os procedimentos internos definidos pela área.

  • Graduação completa ou em andamento nas áreas de Tecnologia da Informação ou afins.

title: Engenheiro(a) de Software Backend - Pleno (Golang)
description:
O seu papel como Software Engineer Pleno (E2)

  • Desenvolver programação do início ao fim, incluindo definições de arquitetura, testes e rollout em produção;
  • Desenvolvimento de projetos com arquitetura de microserviços, consumo e geração de eventos em Streaming, API's;
  • Garantir a funcionalidade, manutenibilidade e velocidade, além de práticas de teste e qualidade;
  • Garantir que todas as soluções técnicas estejam alinhadas a estratégia do negócio e entender iniciativas relacionadas ao produto;
  • Ajudar o time no desenho de soluções com arquitetura evolutiva, além de investigar constantemente novas tecnologias e formas de trabalho;
  • Colaborar com a evolução das habilidades técnicas do time e esforços de melhoria contínua que impactam vários times;
  • Trabalhar em um ambiente colaborativo, em que práticas de pareamento, feedbacks e motivação para se desenvolver são comuns a todos os squads.


O que você precisa para essa posição no jogo:

  • Conhecimento avançado em desenvolvimento em Golang ou Typescript ;
  • Conhecimento sobre desenvolvimento de consumidores e produtores de eventos para Event Streaming (Kafka) ;
  • Conhecimento em Docker & Kubernetes ;
  • Conhecimento com ferramentas de monitoramento e observabilidade ;
  • Conhecimento sobre testes unitários e de integração;
  • Preocupação com a qualidade e desempenho das soluções propostas;
  • Capacidade de trabalhar em um ambiente multifuncional e colaborativo;
  • Conhecimento sobre desenvolvimento e implementação de APIs ;
  • Conhecimento sobre desenvolvimento de microsserviços distribuídos ;
  • Embasamento teórico, habilidade e preocupação com a excelência técnica e boas práticas de desenvolvimento (DDD, Arquitetura, Design de Código, Paradigmas, etc.);
  • Familiaridade com metodologias ágeis.


Seria legal se você conhecesse:

  • Conhecimento em desenvolvimento em C# ;
  • Google Cloud Continuous Integration;
  • Continuous Delivery.

title: Consultor Funcional Tax One

Muito prazer, Somos a Evertec!

A Evertec é uma empresa especializada em tecnologia para o setor financeiro, com mais de 27 anos de atuação e presença em 26 países da América Latina e Caribe. Com mais de 11 bilhões de transações processadas anualmente, somos referência em soluções que impulsionam a transformação digital do mercado.

Oferecemos um portfólio completo de soluções em software, atendendo instituições financeiras, empresas e fintechs que buscam inovação, segurança e eficiência.

Nosso compromisso é com a excelência tecnológica, a inclusão financeira e a geração de valor sustentável para clientes, colaboradores e parceiros, promovendo um ecossistema mais conectado e acessível.


Requisitos

  • Conhecimento e experiência com a solução Tax One.
  • Vivência em gestão de backlog e práticas ágeis (Scrum/Kanban).
  • Experiência na criação e gestão de tickets (definição de regra e municípios).
  • Conhecimento em processos fiscais e legislação tributária.

title: Pessoa Especialista de Desenvolvimento de Sistemas - Full-Stack
description:
#Nosso jeito de fazer história:

Entre para a história de construção do maior Hub de Dados e Analytics do Brasil.

Além de você contribuir diretamente neste objetivo, você estará se desenvolvendo constantemente, por meio de grandes desafios de negócio, junto a um time de alto impacto. Na Neoway, acreditamos em fazer as coisas de forma inovadora, colaborativa, responsável e com foco no cliente.

Falando da área:

Trabalhar na área de Engenharia da Neoway mantém o colaborador conectado com a inovação, ao constante aprimoramento por melhores metodologias de desenvolvimento e a novas tecnologias para atender os objetivos estratégicos e de negócios da Neoway.

Utilizamos metodologias ágeis por princípio e focamos no ciclo de desenvolvimento de produto para oferecer a melhor experiência aos nossos usuários. O time de Engenharia é responsável por construir, evoluir e sustentar todo o ecossistema que compõem nossa plataforma de Big Data Analytics, chamada Plataforma Neoway.


Acreditamos que um software de qualidade é fácil de usar, funciona corretamente, é de fácil manutenção/sustentação, fácil integração e mantém a integridade para evitar possíveis falhas, fora ou não, do controle de quem o desenvolveu.


Para alcançar este objetivo atuamos em dois pilares distintos para garantir a eficiência do processo de desenvolvimento de software assegurando a qualidade junto a um ambiente saudável na área de Engenharia, no aspecto de boas práticas e cultura de desenvolvimento:


1° - Pessoas é um pilar estratégico para Neoway, atuamos de maneira pró ativa em conjunto com todas as áreas da empresa, garantindo o desenvolvimento de talentos, crescimento profissional e formação do nosso DNA, impulsionando a cultura de times de alta performance (liberdade com responsabilidade).


2° - Técnico (Paved Way), acreditamos que ferramental e a automação ajudam a dimensionar a capacidade de um time, mas nenhuma ferramenta resolverá todos os problemas na produtividade no desenvolvimento ou nas operações. A ideia é ter um conjunto de ferramentas e práticas de “paved way” que são formalmente suportadas por algumas pessoas.   • Experiência avançada em frameworks de frontend (Vue.js, Angular).
  • Conhecimento em bancos de dados relacionais e não relacionais (PostgreSQL, MongoDB, etc.).

  • Prática com versionamento de código e pipelines CI/CD.

  • Boa comunicação e habilidade de articular ideias em um ambiente colaborativo.
  • Postura proativa e capacidade de lidar com mudanças como oportunidades de aprendizado.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Perfil do Consultor de Vendas: Proativo, dinâmico, comunicativo, habilidade em negociação, organizado, foco no cliente e metas de vendas;

Salário Fixo + Remuneração Variável + Bônus Mensal

title: Public Relations Manager - LATAM
description:
About Cooler Master

Cooler Master is a global computer hardware manufacturer founded in 1992 in Taiwan. The company is known for its award-winning PC components, including cases, power supplies, cooling solutions, and accessories.


In addition to retail product lines, Cooler Master also serves as an OEM partner to major technology brands worldwide. The company has grown steadily through a strong focus on innovation, design, and user-driven product development. Headquartered in Taipei, Cooler Master operates manufacturing facilities in China and maintains regional offices across the globe.


Role Overview

Lead public relations for Latin America (LATAM) to elevate Cooler Master’s visibility across key markets such as Brazil, Mexico, Argentina, and Chile.

You’ll manage PR execution for launches and ongoing brand activations—aligning local media, translating technical information into engaging stories, and ensuring consistent communication with global and regional marketing teams.


Key Responsibilities

  • Own the LATAM PR Plan – Develop and execute the regional PR calendar and embargo plan; ensure alignment with global launches and LATAM sales priorities.
  • Build Media Relationships – Cultivate strong connections with top-tier tech and gaming editors, reviewers, and influencers across Portuguese and Spanish-speaking markets.
  • Host Press Briefings & Events – Lead virtual and local events; manage press lists, invitations, materials, and post-event follow-ups.
  • Coordinate Product Reviews – Manage the sample allocation, delivery, and follow-up process with regional media outlets.
  • Partner Collaboration – Drive joint PR opportunities with distributors, e-commerce partners, and brand collaborators.
  • Content Localization – Adapt global press materials for LATAM audiences to ensure cultural and linguistic accuracy.
  • Monitor & Report – Track press coverage, analyze media performance metrics, and deliver post-launch summaries.
  • Maintain Compliance – Ensure consistent application of embargoes, NDA terms, and authorized content usage.


Qualifications

  • Education : Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Communications, Journalism, Marketing, or related field.
  • Experience : 5–8+ years in tech, consumer electronics, or gaming PR across LATAM. Proven track record in media relations and launch management.
  • Regional Expertise :
  • Strong understanding of LATAM media ecosystem and regional communication styles.
  • Existing relationships with major tech and gaming outlets.
  • Language Skills :
  • Fluent in English and either Portuguese or Spanish (bilingual proficiency preferred).
  • Execution & Measurement :
  • Strong organizational skills, ability to manage multiple launches.
  • Familiarity with PR metrics such as share of voice and media reach.


Who You Are

  • A proactive communicator with high accountability and attention to detail.
  • Skilled at relationship-building across diverse markets and cultures.
  • Confident managing embargoes, timelines, and media expectations.
  • Adaptable and independent, yet collaborative with global teammates.

title: Mecânico industrial C
description:
Na Agropalma, há muita coisa boa à sua espera. Então, se você é um profissional apaixonado por aprendizado e gosta de trabalhar em união, venha fazer parte do nosso time! Juntos, alcançaremos nosso objetivos.

Estamos em busca de um MECÃNICO INDUSTRIAL C para a região de LIMEIRA/SÃO PAULO.

#VemSerAgropalma


Descrição Breve do Cargo:

  • Realizar manutenção preventiva e/ou corretiva em compressores de ar, trocadores de calor, sistemas de vapor e condensado, bombas centrifugas, helicoidais e dosadoras;
  • Recolocar vedações das placas do filtro, desmontando partes mecânicas, conjuntos e subconjuntos, substituindo peças, efetuando a montagem dos equipamentos, verificando o funcionamento dentro dos padrões preestabelecidos;
  • Participar da realização de serviços de manutenção de maior grau de complexidade; efetuando a desmontagem, substituição de peças e montagem de conjuntos e subconjuntos;
  • Realizar correções de baixo rendimento, removendo, limpando e recolocando placas de filtros, trocando anéis de vedação e fazendo ajustes.


Instrução

  • Ensino Médio Completo e Curso técnico em Mecânica/Mecatrônica;


Desejável

  • NR-35, NR-33;
  • Experiência de 6 meses em funções semelhantes.


Localidade

  • Limeira/SP
  • Americana/SP


Nossa Empresa

Somos a maior produtora de óleo sustentável da América Latina, reconhecida em todo o mundo pela qualidade superior de nossos produtos e processos, e pelo compromisso com o meio ambiente e as pessoas. Geramos cerca de 5mil empregos diretos e desenvolvemos projetos socioambientais que impactam direta e indiretamente na vida de todos.


Temos operações no Pará e em São Paulo. Nossos plantios e fábricas de extração ficam situados em Tailândia/PA, onde iniciamos nossa trajetória em 1982. Também possuíamos modernas refinarias nas cidades de Belém/PA e Limeira/SP. Especificamente, na unidade de Limeira, temos uma refinaria multióleos, com equipamentos de última geração e um Centro de Inovação pronto para atender às indústrias de panificação, sorvetes, confeitaria, food service, lácteos, cosméticos e produtos não alimentícios (químicos e oleoquímicos).


Mais do que desenvolver produtos de qualidade, nosso objetivo é cooperar para um mundo melhor. Tanto que dos nossos 107 mil hectares de terra, destinamos 64 mil a áreas de reservas florestais preservadas e monitoradas, com riquíssima biodiversidade. Em Tailândia/PA, mantemos agrovilas com completa infraestrutura para nossos colaboradores, com escola, clubes e academia.

title: AWS Administrator
description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world!! Here you can transform your career!

Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.

We are looking for (job name) who wants to learn and transform his career.

In this role you will: (responsibilities)

glish fluently

An AWS Administrator specializing in Kubernetes, particularly with Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (EKS), requires a robust set of skills encompassing both cloud infrastructure and container orchestration

AWS Services:

Proficiency in core AWS services like EC2, S3, VPC, IAM, CloudWatch, Route 53, EBS, and EFS. Understanding how these integrate with EKS is crucial.


Networking:

Strong understanding of AWS networking concepts, including VPCs, subnets, security groups, NACLs, and routing tables, and how they apply to Kubernetes clusters.


Security:

Knowledge of AWS security best practices, IAM roles and policies, and securing EKS clusters.


Automation & Scripting:

Experience with scripting languages like Python or Bash for automating AWS tasks and managing infrastructure as code (e.g., using CloudFormation or Terraform).

Kubernetes Fundamentals:

Deep understanding of Kubernetes architecture, including control plane components (API server, etcd, scheduler, controller manager) and worker node components (kubelet, kube-proxy, container runtime).


Containerization:

Expertise in Docker or other container runtimes, including image building, registry management, and container best practices.


Workload Management:

Ability to deploy, manage, and scale applications using Kubernetes objects like Pods, Deployments, Services, Ingress, ConfigMaps, and Secrets.


Networking:

Understanding of Kubernetes networking concepts, including CNI plugins, Service networking, Ingress controllers, and DNS resolution within the cluster.


Storage:

Knowledge of Kubernetes storage options, including Persistent Volumes, Persistent Volume Claims, and Storage Classes, particularly with AWS storage integrations.


Monitoring & Logging:

Experience with monitoring and logging solutions for Kubernetes, such as Prometheus, Grafana, ELK/EFK stack, or AWS CloudWatch Container Insights.


Troubleshooting:

Strong troubleshooting skills to diagnose and resolve issues within EKS clusters and containerized applications.


Helm & Kustomize:

Familiarity with package managers like Helm for deploying and managing Kubernetes applications, and Kustomize for configuration customization.


CI/CD:

Understanding of CI/CD pipelines and how to integrate Kubernetes deployments into automated workflows.

What can you expect from us?

• Professional development and constant evolution of your skills, always in line with your interests.

• Opportunities to work outside Brazil

• A collaborative, diverse and innovative environment that encourages teamwork.

What do we offer?

TCS Benefits – Brazil:

Health insurance

Dental Plan

Life insurance

Transportation vouchers

Meal/Food Voucher

Childcare assistance

Gympass

TCS Cares – free 0800 that provides psychological assistance (24 hrs/day), legal, social and financial assistance to associates

Partnership with SESC

Reimbursement of Certifications

Free TCS Learning Portal – Online courses and live training

International experience opportunity

Discount Partnership with Universities and Language Schools

Bring Your Buddy – By referring people you become eligible to receive a bonus for each hire

TCS Gems – Recognition for performance

Xcelerate – Free Mentoring Career Platform

At TATA Consultancy Services we promote an inclusive culture, we always work for equity. This applies to Gender, People with Disabilities, LGBTQIA+, Religion, Race, Ethnicity. All our opportunities are based on these principles. We think of different actions of inclusion and social responsibility, in order to build a TCS that respects individuality. Come to be a TCSer!

Experiência prática em ITOM/ITAM

Experiência prática em ITOM/ITAM

Mínimo de 2 anos de experiência com ServiceNow.

Certificação ServiceNow CSA é obrigatoria

Certificação CIS nos modulos de ITOM / ITAM

Certificação ITIL desajável

Experiência com metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban).

Inglês para conversação será um diferencial.

Conhecimento em desenvolvimento de portais no ServiceNow.

Experiência prática em outros módulos como por exemplo: Information Technology Service Management (ITSM), Portal, AppEngine e Customer Service Management (CSM) na plataforma ServiceNow.

Ceriticações (CIS) de outros módulos do ServiceNow

title: Data Solutions Architect (inglês fluente)
description:
#VAGA REMOTA para Arquiteto de Dados / Tech Lead

Modelo Contractor/PJ via Deel – Longo Prazo

Inglês Fluente Obrigatório

Atuação 100% remota (alinhamento com fuso dos EUA)


A Stefanini LATAM está apoiando uma organização global em Data & Analytics na criação de seu hub nearshore para ampliar a cobertura operacional em horários críticos.

Buscamos um(a) Arquiteto de Dados ou Tech Lead em Dados com perfil Técnico-Estratégico para atuar como líder técnico da operação nearshore e referência de arquitetura em um ambiente corporativo de larga escala.


Responsabilidades Técnicas

  • Definir e evoluir a arquitetura de dados corporativa, garantindo padronização, escalabilidade e governança.
  • Modelagem de dados (conceitual, lógico e físico) para data lakes, data warehouses e data platforms modernos.
  • Liderar o desenho e gerenciamento de pipelines de ingestão (batch e CDC), replicação e transformação.
  • Avaliar performance de ingestão, linhagem, versionamento e qualidade de dados.
  • Integrar sistemas hospedados em ambientes híbridos (GCP, Azure, SQL Server).
  • Apoiar iniciativas avançadas (ML/GenAI/Analytics), garantindo readiness e arquitetura adequada.
  • Ser o ponto estratégico do nearshore para decisões de arquitetura, garantindo alinhamento com times da Índia, EUA e demais hubs.
  • Traduzir necessidades de negócio em soluções técnicas escaláveis e sustentáveis.


Requisitos Técnicos

  • Experiência sólida como Arquiteto(a) de Dados, Data Solutions Architect ou Enterprise Data Architect.
  • Forte domínio de arquitetura moderna de dados (medallion, lakehouse, data mesh, pipelines distribuídos).
  • Experiência prática com:
  • Azure Data Factory (ADF)
  • SQL Server (OLTP/OLAP)
  • CDC / replicação de dados – preferencialmente Click Replicate
  • Integração entre GCP e ecossistemas Microsoft
  • Conhecimento avançado de modelagem, governança, versionamento e gestão de ciclo de vida de dados.
  • Fluência em inglês (interação diária com lideranças globais).
  • Capacidade comprovada de tomada de decisão técnica, liderança e direcionamento arquitetural.


Diferenciais

  • Experiência com Microsoft Fabric .
  • Background em plataformas analíticas e machine learning.
  • Atuação em ambientes corporativos complexos e distribuídos.



Se você possui senioridade técnica, visão arquitetural e deseja liderar a evolução de uma plataforma de dados global, este é o desafio ideal.

title: Desenvolvedor(a) Front-End | Hablla
description:
Sobre a Hablla

A Hablla é a plataforma líder em Marketing Conversacional Integrado (MCI) — uma evolução do RevOps que conecta Marketing, Vendas, Atendimento, Customer Success e Business Performance em um único fluxo conversacional.

Nosso propósito é redefinir a comunicação entre marcas e pessoas, utilizando Inteligência Artificial Generativa e automação inteligente para transformar dados em resultados concretos.

Se você busca desafios técnicos, quer trabalhar com produtos digitais de alta escala e participar da construção de uma solução proprietária inovadora essa parceria é para você.


Responsabilidades

  • Desenvolver interfaces modernas e de alta performance utilizando React.js e TypeScript , com foco em escalabilidade, responsividade e experiência do usuário.
  • Colaborar com times multidisciplinares de UX, backend, dados e produto, em um ambiente de desenvolvimento ágil.
  • Participar da definição e manutenção do Design System e dos padrões de arquitetura front-end.
  • Implementar e manter o gerenciamento de estado utilizando Redux com Redux-Saga .
  • Garantir a qualidade técnica do código, seguindo boas práticas de clean code e componentização.


Requisitos

  • Experiência sólida com React.js , TypeScript , HTML5 , CSS3/Tailwind e consumo de APIs REST.
  • Domínio de Redux e Redux-Saga .
  • Experiência com Vite ou Next.js .
  • Conhecimento de Git e GitHub para versionamento e colaboração.
  • Familiaridade com práticas de Clean Architecture , Hooks , componentização e testes unitários .
  • Mentalidade orientada a produto, com foco em performance e experiência do usuário.


Diferenciais

  • Vivência com integrações omnichannel (WhatsApp, Meta, e-mail e telefonia).
  • Experiência com Figma e colaboração com times de UX/UI.
  • Conhecimento em sistemas colaborativos em tempo real .
  • Interesse em IA aplicada à interface e personalização de jornada do usuário.
  • Ter trabalhado em ferramentas de CRM e/ou Omnichannel.


O que oferecemos

  • Ambiente 100% remoto e colaborativo.
  • Cultura ágil, horizontal e orientada a resultados.
  • Contato direto com os founders e time de produto.
  • Oportunidade de crescimento em uma startup em expansão internacional .

  • Cultura ágil, horizontal e orientada a resultados.

description:
About HCLTech


HCLTech is a global technology company, spread across 60 countries, delivering industry-leading capabilities centered around digital, engineering, cloud and AI, powered by a broad portfolio of technology services and products. We work with clients across all major verticals, providing industry solutions for Financial Services, Manufacturing, Life Sciences and Healthcare, Technology and Services, Telecom and Media, Retail and CPG, and Public Services. We re powered by our people a global, diverse, multi-generational talent - representing 161 nationalities whose unique spark, perspective and boundless passion drive our culture of proactive value creation and problem-solving.


To learn more about how we can supercharge progress for you, visit


Key Responsibilities

• Design and develop end-to-end solutions using Azure services including Azure Container Apps, CosmosDB, Azure Functions, and Azure DevOps.

• Build scalable, secure, and maintainable cloud-native applications.

• Lead technical design sessions and create architecture diagrams and documentation.

• Collaborate with cross-functional teams including product, security, and UI/UX.

• Present technical solutions and roadmaps to stakeholders and leadership.


Qualifications

• Hands-on experience in software development and solution architecture.

• Deep expertise in Azure PaaS services, especially CosmosDB, Azure Container Apps, and Azure Functions.

• Experience with CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure as code, and DevOps practices.

• Excellent presentation and communication skills—able to clearly articulate technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.

• Familiarity with AI/ML integration and secure cloud architecture is a plus.

title: Engenheiro de dados
description:
Contratação PJ

Atuação remota


Sobre o projeto

  • Projeto estratégico com grande volume de dados e foco em arquiteturas de baixo custo .
  • Atuação em iniciativas críticas relacionadas à transformação e integração de dados.


Nossa stack

  • GCP (BigQuery, Pub/Sub, Cloud Tasks, Storage, Cloud Run, Compute Engine, DataProc, DataFlow)
  • Cursor para desenvolvimento diário
  • Python para processamento de dados e automações
  • APIs com Flask e FastAPI


Responsabilidades

  • Desenvolver e otimizar pipelines de dados em GCP .
  • Implementar estratégias para redução de custos e aumento de performance.
  • Criar serviços e APIs para integração de dados.
  • Trabalhar com arquiteturas escaláveis e eficientes.


Requisitos

  • Experiência sólida com GCP e seus principais serviços.
  • Forte domínio em Python para processamento de dados.
  • Vivência com arquiteturas econômicas e escaláveis .
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas de desenvolvimento como Cursor .
  • Perfil proativo e orientado à solução.

title: Video Editor
description:
We are…

A leading digital media and content production group with a large global presence. At EMP, we believe in the power of content to unite and inspire people. With our innovative approach and content-first mentality, we're redefining how content is consumed and shared. We help create content at the highest level including some of the biggest professional athlete led podcasts in the world.


Like all winning teams, we value respect, creativity, and fun. We operate in a dynamic environment where collaboration drives ideation and where you will help shape the ever-growing sports media landscape as we know it. Here at EMP, we provide an opportunity for your voice to be heard and create a space where you can have fun in the process. We’re not just about work, rather we look to build a community that celebrates victories, learns from hardships, and grows as one. EMP is a place where your talent can shine while you make a real impact along the way.


You Are...

An experienced and driven video editor professional with experience producing quality video edits, ideally within the media, entertainment, or sports industry. You are passionate about growth, entrepreneurial in spirit, and able to work in collaboration with a team

You Will...

  • Edit audio and video for podcast, YouTube videos, advertisments, branded content, and more to create high-quality, color corrected, synchronized video content.
  • Ensure audio clarity, correct sync issues, and enhance sound quality with noise reduction, EQ, and other techniques.
  • Add intro/outro music, sound effects, and transitions for a professional and polished final product.
  • Select impactful or interesting moments from episodes to create shorter video clips for social media platforms (e.g., Instagram, YouTube, TikTok).
  • Tailor clips for specific platform requirements (aspect ratios, length, captioning) and audience engagement.
  • Add dynamic motion graphics, lower thirds, captions, and animations to enhance viewer experience.
  • Create and integrate title cards, branding elements, and background visuals in alignment with the podcast’s visual identity
  • Work closely with hosts, producers, and social media managers to align on styles, themes, key messages, and desired tone
  • and more...


Job Requirements

You Have...

  • The ability to speak advanced to fluent English
  • Minimum 2-3 years of experience in video editing, preferably with podcast or interview-style content.
  • Skills Adobe Premiere Pro, Final Cut Pro, or similar video editing software; familiarity with audio software (e.g., Audacity, Adobe Audition) is a plus.
  • Strong understanding of sound design, color correction, and high level motion graphics/animations.
  • Excellent attention to detail and quality control in all aspects of editing.
  • Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate effectively with multiple teams.
  • Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously and meet deadlines.
  • Demonstrated experience through a portfolio of video editing work.

title: Payroll Administrator
description:
About Turing



Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises looking to deploy advanced AI systems. Turing accelerates frontier research with high-quality data, specialized talent, and training pipelines that advance thinking, reasoning, coding, multimodality, and STEM. For enterprises, Turing builds proprietary intelligence systems that integrate AI into mission-critical workflows, unlock transformative outcomes, and drive lasting competitive advantage.

Recognized by Forbes, The Information, and Fast Company among the world’s top innovators, Turing’s leadership team includes AI technologists from Meta, Google, Microsoft, Apple, Amazon, McKinsey, Bain, Stanford, Caltech, and MIT. Learn more at



Role Overview:



We have an exciting opportunity for a Payroll Administrator to help with our growing global payroll processes. This role will own the Brazil payroll process but will be hands-on in many other aspects of our payroll operations through data collection, process streamlining, and entity creation. This is a great growth role for anyone wanting to expand their payroll career in a global setting.

Our ideal candidate is a hands-on self-starter who is analytical and methodical, with 4+ years of experience in payroll operations. We also value integrity, team spirit, and strong organizational skills.

This role is fully remote and based in Brazil, however, this role will be dealing with payroll across geographies as we grow.



Responsibilities:



  • Process Brazil payroll for employees in the Deel platform. This will include the monthly regular cycle and all off-cycle payrolls as needed for new hires/terminations.
  • Manage workflow to ensure incoming and outgoing payroll data is processed timely and accurately. Serve as the main point of contact for the Deel payroll team.
  • Remittance of Brazilian employee payroll deposits and monthly FGTS/INSS payroll tax payments.
  • Ability to understand union agreement(s) and serve as a point of contact for employee and/or vendor questions in relation.
  • Knowledge of Brazil payroll tax compliance to ensure the accuracy of system settings and processed transactions.
  • Help to ensure payroll-related tax account registrations are completed as needed.
  • Work closely with our internal accounting department to provide support on payroll-related questions or documentation as needed.
  • Own data collection, entries, and accuracy across multiple systems that impact global payroll operations.
  • Assist employees with inquiries related to payroll matters.
  • Assist with month-end, quarter-end, and year-end payroll processes and related tax reconciliations.
  • Cross-functional collaboration with business partners (People/Benefits/Finance) for process improvements and efficiencies.
  • Create and/or maintain payroll documentation as it relates to processing, operational procedures, compliance, and other payroll-related matters.
  • Assist in ad-hoc duties when required (ie. audits, payroll backup for other entities, external payment operations, etc.)



Skills/Qualifications Required:



  • Minimum of 2-4 years of payroll processing.
  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively with team members and other stakeholders.
  • Exposure to a SOX-regulated environment is preferred but not required.
  • Self-motivated, detail-oriented, and proven to have excellent time management skills to deliver results in a fast-paced environment. Strong organizational skills; ability to meet deadlines across multiple tasks.
  • Recent processing experience with Deel or other third-party payroll providers. Exposure to ADP Workforce Now, HiBob, Slack, Jira, and Jibble preferred.
  • Knowledge of Sao Paulo Union agreements and Brazilian labor laws; must be able to read agreements and relay relevant information to team(s) as needed.
  • Strong communication skills, written/verbal, and the ability to interact with employees at all levels. Must be proficient in written and verbal English. Bilingual Portuguese preferred.
  • Strong MS Excel skills required (VLOOKUP’s, Pivot Tables, etc.)



Advantages of joining Turing:


  • Amazing work culture (Super collaborative & supportive work environment; 5 days a week)
  • Awesome colleagues (Surround yourself with top talent from Meta, Google, LinkedIn etc. as well as people with deep startup experience)
  • Competitive compensation
  • Flexible working hours

title: Machine Learning Engineer
description:
We are still looking for talent… and we would love for you to join our team!

For over 25 years, UST has worked alongside the world’s best companies to make a real impact through business transformation. Driven by technology, inspired by people, and guided by our purpose, UST supports clients from design to implementation. Together, with more than 30,000 employees in 30 countries, we build to create limitless impact, reaching billions of lives in the process.


About the Role: we’re looking for a talented Machine Learning Engineer to join our growing AI team!


About the Role

As an ML Engineer on our team, you will design, train, fine-tune, and deploy ML/LLM models that power autonomous exception resolution, anomaly detection, and explainable insights. You’ll work hands-on with multiple LLM ecosystems like OpenAI GPT, Anthropic Claude, Google Gemini, and Meta LLaMA. You will implement retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) pipelines, develop prompt engineering and safety techniques, and integrate memory and explainability into agentic workflows.


Key Responsibilities

  • Design, train, fine-tune, and deploy ML/LLM models for production.
  • Build RAG pipelines using vector databases and frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, and MCP.
  • Develop prompt engineering, optimization, and safety techniques for agentic LLM interactions.
  • Collaborate with data engineering to maintain data pipelines for ML workloads.
  • Conduct feature engineering and embeddings generation on structured and unstructured data.
  • Implement model monitoring, drift detection, and retraining pipelines.
  • Explore emerging LLM/SLM architectures and multi-agent orchestration patterns.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with R&D, data science, product, and engineering teams.
  • Mentor junior engineers and contribute to best practices in ML engineering.


Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Machine Learning, or related field.
  • 3+ years building and deploying ML systems.
  • English advance (B2)
  • Strong Python skills and experience with PyTorch, TensorFlow, Scikit-Learn, Hugging Face Transformers.
  • Hands-on experience with LLMs/SLMs including fine-tuning, prompt design, and inference optimization.
  • Familiarity with at least two of the following: OpenAI GPT, Anthropic Claude, Google Gemini, Meta LLaMA.
  • Knowledge of vector databases, embeddings, and RAG pipelines.
  • Experience working with both structured and unstructured data at scale.
  • Understanding of SQL and distributed data frameworks like Spark or Ray.
  • Deep knowledge of ML lifecycle: data preparation, training, evaluation, deployment, and monitoring.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with agentic frameworks (LangChain, LangGraph, MCP, AutoGen).
  • Understanding of AI safety, guardrails, and explainability.
  • Hands-on experience deploying ML/LLM solutions on AWS, GCP, or Azure.
  • Familiarity with MLOps practices including CI/CD, monitoring, and observability.
  • Background in anomaly detection, fraud/risk modeling, or behavioral analytics.
  • Contributions to open-source AI/ML projects or research publications.


UST is waiting for you!

title: Sales Manager -  Nutraceutical Ingredients ( LATAM)
description:
Sales Manager - Nutraceutical Ingredients ( LATAM)


Location: Brazil (Remote)


Territory: Latin America


About the Role


We’re seeking a Sales Manager to drive growth across LATAM. You will sell nutraceutical ingredients to the dietary supplement and functional food & beverage industries, building a high-quality pipeline and long-term customer relationships.


Responsibilities

• Manage and grow key accounts across LATAM, fostering senior-level relationships with brand owners, CDMOs/contract manufacturers, and distributors.

• Develop and execute country- and segment-level territory plans to capture new business.

• Present nutraceutical ingredients to customers, clearly articulating benefits, applications, and go-to-market plans.

• Collaborate with technical, regulatory, and marketing teams to deliver tailored solutions and product launches.

• Monitor market trends and competitor activity to identify white space and protect share.

• Meet and exceed quarterly/annual sales targets with accurate forecasting and disciplined CRM hygiene.

• Represent the company at regional trade shows, conferences, and industry events.

• Provide technical/product support to customers in coordination with internal teams.

• Maintain up-to-date knowledge of regional regulations and standards (e.g., ANVISA, COFEPRIS, INVIMA).


Requirements

• 5+ years of B2B sales experience in nutraceutical ingredients within LATAM.

• Strong understanding of nutraceutical ingredients and their applications in dietary supplements and functional F&B.

• Proven ability to prospect, build pipelines, negotiate, and close across multiple countries.

• Language: Fluent Portuguese and strong Spanish; English is a plus.

• Self-starter comfortable working remotely; excellent territory/time management.

• Based in Brazil with willingness to travel across LATAM as required.

• Proficiency with MS Office and CRM (ZOHO preferred).

title: Data Warehouse Architect
description:
Databricks Data Warehouse ArchitectAbout the role:

One of the largest companies in the world in the Gaming industry is seeking a hands-on Data Architect with DataWarehouse Engineer expertise in Databricks (DBX) and AWS-native data services to spearhead the design and implementation of a new data warehouse instance for a major product line. This role will involve building from the ground up—architecting scalable pipelines, optimizing lakehouse performance, and integrating seamlessly with diverse real-time and batch data sources across AWS.

The ideal candidate is passionate about data architecture , thrives in fast-moving environments, and has a proven track record of setting up high-performance lakehouse platforms on Databricks with a strong foundation in data warehousing principles .

Key Responsibilities:
  • Design and deploy a new Databricks Lakehouse instance tailored to the client’s product-level data needs.
  • Architect and implement robust data ingestion pipelines using Spark (PySpark/Scala) and Delta Lake.
  • Integrate AWS-native services (S3, Glue, Athena, Redshift, Lambda) with Databricks for optimized performance and scalability.
  • Define data models, optimize query performance, and establish warehouse governance best practices.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with product teams, data scientists, and DevOps to streamline data workflows.
  • Maintain CI/CD, preferably DBX for data pipelines using GitOps and Infrastructure-as-Code.

description:
Estamos buscando entusiastas do esporte que residam perto dos estados abaixo para se juntarem à nossa equipe como coletores de dados para eventos de futebol. Qualificações e Requisitos:

  • Conhecimento básico de inglês
  • Possuir um dispositivo Android/iPhone

  • Não é necessário ter formação em jornalismo

Oferecemos:

  • Trabalho perfeito para estudantes ou para complementar a renda
  • Treinamento completo e gratuito
  • 62 euros (aproximadamente 405 reais) por partida coberta, além de reembolso de despesas de viagem e ingressos


Estados onde precisamos urgentemente de pessoas para coleta de dados nos locais dos jogos:

  • Alagoas

⚡Own It: Ter espírito de dono te faz conquistar a liberdade. Valorizamos a autonomia e a proatividade, somos responsáveis pelo o que entregamos e queremos sempre evoluir o nosso negócio.

Live the Ride: Faça. Feito é melhor que perfeito. Aprendemos com os erros e encaramos desafios como oportunidades de aprendizado.

No Bullshit: Agir com simplicidade. Somos pessoas práticas, sinceras e gostamos de feedbacks. Sabemos que às vezes vamos errar e contamos com essa transparência para evoluirmos.

title: Desenvolvedor Fullstack (Node.js + React Native)
description:
Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.

Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 60 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, projetos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação. Apoiamos nossos clientes para encontrar a melhor maneira que seu gap de talentos seja endereçado, de maneira a suportar seu processo de transformação digital. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. — Atuar em um assessment técnico com foco em análise profunda da base atual das aplicações Web e Mobile.

— Revisar código das aplicações desenvolvidas em Node.js e React Native , avaliando qualidade, padrões utilizados e aderência às boas práticas.

— Identificar bugs, riscos, dívidas técnicas e oportunidades de melhoria técnica e arquitetural.

— Mapear integrações, APIs, serviços e dependências do sistema, garantindo entendimento completo da estrutura atual.

— Documentar os achados, pontos críticos e recomendações, apoiando o time técnico na definição dos próximos passos.

— Contribuir com insights técnicos para melhoria contínua do código e estabilidade da aplicação.


O que você precisa ter

— Forte experiência prática com Node.js e React Native (Web e Mobile).

— Vivência consistente com revisão de código (code review) e análise estrutural de aplicações.

— Conhecimento sólido de boas práticas , padrões de desenvolvimento e qualidade de código.

— Capacidade analítica para identificar problemas em bases legadas, arquiteturas pouco padronizadas e integrações complexas.

— Vivência em ambientes com múltiplas integrações (REST, microserviços, filas, etc.).

— Experiência prévia com auditoria de código, due diligence técnica ou assessment de sistemas.

title: Senior FullStack Developer (Java+React) [Portugal]
description:
This vacancy is for our Portuguese team and you will have to relocate to Portugal.


We’re launching a new partnership with a valued client in fintech, and we’re growing our team to support this exciting collaboration

Client is a financial sciences company, combining data analysis, invention, and rigorous inquiry to help solve the toughest challenges in investment management, insurance technology, securities, private equity, and venture capital.


Project Overview:

The platform is a portfolio analytics tool used by asset owners, asset managers, and advisors.

The platform applies the best expertise in research, data science, and technology to modernize the analytics experience for institutional investors, helping them embrace a quantitative approach to multi-asset portfolio risk and investment decision making.

The available tools help investors perform factor-based risk analysis to inform manager due diligence, investment evaluation, and portfolio construction.

The client's headquarters is in the USA

We are seeking an experienced, full-stack Software Engineer to help own the innovation, technical design, and development of the platform.

Technology Stack:

  • Cloud based, modern web application stack using Java, Typescript, React.js
  • Apollo GraphQL as an popular open-source ecosystem for building and managing GraphQL APIs
  • Service oriented architecture, infrastructure-as-code
  • Continuous development and deployment
  • Auto-scaling and robust search (Postgres, OpenSearch)
  • Cloud technologies (AWS)
  • Cloud monitoring (Datadog)
  • Test automation (Cypress)


Requirements:

  • 7+ years of experience preferred building and delivering customer facing products
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or related technical discipline
  • 7+ years of Experience with Java development
  • 3+ years of Experience with modern front-end technologies: React.js, TypeScript, JavaScript**
  • Experience with relational and NoSQL databases, test automation, DevOps and cloud technologies (AWS preferred)
  • Prior experience with systems design, building enterprise SaaS solutions, experience with user research, and product analytics are a major plus
  • Strong communication skills , keen attention to detail, readiness to challenge assumptions and obsession with building quality software


Responsibilities:

  • Create, design, build and deploy SaaS product end to end with an agile approach, from conceptualization, through rigorous testing, and partnering with client´s multi-functional teams to ensure an outstanding in-product UX
  • Conduct front-end web development using React, TypeScript, CSS, and other technologies
  • Perform API design and development in Java, using cloud, microservices, and caching
  • Become a domain expert and trusted advisor in the full-stack software engineering field
  • Contribute to the continuous learning approach of the team by bringing in new insights, welcoming them from others, and generating even stronger outcomes as a result
  • Provide hands-on coding support and perform code reviews to ensure quality standards
  • Communicate clearly about progress, challenges, and technical decisions


Let us know if this challenge is for you!

description:
Sobre nós


A Kiwify é uma das maiores plataformas de infoprodutos do Brasil, possibilitando que qualquer pessoa crie e venda seus cursos online.


Somos acelerados pela Y Combinator, do Vale do Silício, e hoje já impactamos milhões de usuários.


Agora estamos dando o próximo passo e criando a Conta Digital da Kiwify, que já nasce com alcance massivo e um canal único de distribuição através dos maiores influenciadores do país.


Acreditamos que a Kiwify se tornará uma das maiores contas digitais do Brasil, e queremos pessoas excepcionais para construir essa história com a gente.



Modelo


  • Remoto



Período


  • Segunda à sexta, das 09h às 18h00 (1h de intervalo)



Benefícios


  • VR/VA – R$ 1.000,00 (Flash Benefícios)
  • Plano de Saúde
  • Plano Odontológico
  • WellHub – Gympass



Responsabilidades


  • Liderar o time de PLD e Compliance, garantindo processos robustos de prevenção à lavagem de dinheiro, prevenção a fraudes e financiamento ao terrorismo.


  • Desenvolver políticas, normas e procedimentos alinhados às regulamentações do Banco Central e melhores práticas de mercado.


  • Implementar e aprimorar sistemas de monitoramento de transações suspeitas, alertas e relatórios regulatórios.


  • Conduzir investigações internas e análises de clientes, colaboradores, fornecedores e parceiros (KYC, KYE, KYP e Due Diligence).


  • Assegurar a entrega tempestiva e correta de reportes obrigatórios (COAF, Bacen, entre outros).


  • Trabalhar lado a lado com áreas de Risco, Operações e Jurídico para mitigar riscos regulatórios e reputacionais.


  • Fomentar uma cultura de conformidade dentro da empresa, com treinamentos recorrentes e comunicação clara.



Requisitos


  • Pelo menos 3 anos de experiência em posição de liderança em PLD/Compliance em fintechs, bancos ou instituições financeiras.


  • Experiência em desenvolver e implementar políticas, normas e procedimentos de PLD alinhados às exigências regulatórias e melhores práticas internacionais.


  • Conhecimento sólido das regulamentações brasileiras (BACEN, COAF, CVM, SUSEP) e normas internacionais (FATF, OFAC, AMLD).


  • Experiência comprovada em liderar times de PLD, contratar, treinar e desligar profissionais da área.


  • Capacidade de estruturar processos e times de PLD em empresas em rápido crescimento.


  • Forte senso de urgência, responsabilidade e mentalidade hands-on.


  • Comunicação clara, objetiva e com alta capacidade de alinhamento interdepartamental.

  • Nosso site:
